Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStream.Data.DataFrame Imports OneStream.Data.DataFrame.Abstractions Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800 Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName Public Class CMD_UFR_Sql_Tbl_Editor_Svc Implements IWsasSqlTableEditorV800 Private si As SessionInfo Public globals As BRGlobals Private workspace As DashboardWorkspace Private args As DashboardExtenderArgs Private api As Object
Public Function SqlTableEditorSaveData(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal workspace As DashboardWorkspace, ByVal args As DashboardExtenderArgs) As XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult Implements IWsasSqlTableEditorV800.SqlTableEditorSaveData
'Assign to global variables Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.workspace = workspace Me.args = args Me.api = api
Try If (globals IsNot Nothing) AndAlso (workspace IsNot Nothing) AndAlso (args IsNot Nothing) AndAlso (args.SqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo IsNot Nothing) AndAlso (args.SqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition IsNot Nothing) Then If args.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("SaveManageTable") Then Dim saveDataTaskInfo As XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo = args.SqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo
Select Case saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.TableName.ToLower() Case "xfc_cmd_mg_workflow" Return Save_XFC_CMD_MG_Workflow() Case "xfc_cmd_required_fields" Return Save_XFC_CMD_Required_Fields() End Select
End If End If Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw New XFException(si, ex) End Try End Function
#Region "Function: Save_XFC_CMD_MG_Workflow - Save Manage Workflow table" Private Function Save_XFC_CMD_MG_Workflow() As Object Dim saveDataTaskInfo As XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo = args.SqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo Dim saveDataTaskResult As New XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult() Dim errorResult As New XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult()
Dim wfInfoDetails = GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim CMDName As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim WFTimeName As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
Dim editedCombinations As New HashSet(Of Tuple(Of String, String, String)) Dim Command As Object Dim oModule As Object Dim Level As Object Dim currentStatus As Object Dim newStatus As Object Dim Action As Object
For Each editedRow As XFEditedDataRow In saveDataTaskInfo.EditedDataRows If editedRow.InsertUpdateOrDelete.ToString() = "Delete" Then Continue For End If Command = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Command") oModule = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Module") Level = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Level") currentStatus = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Current_Status") newStatus = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("New_Status") Action = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Action")
'--- Check if there are null values for Level, Current Status, and New Status If (Level Is DBNull.Value OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Level.ToString())) OrElse _ (currentStatus Is DbNull.Value OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(currentStatus.ToString())) OrElse _ (newStatus Is DbNull.Value OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newStatus.ToString())) Then
errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Level, Current Status, and New Status cannot be blank. Please fill in all required fields before saving." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True
Return errorResult End If
'--- Check if Current Status already exists If Command IsNot DBNull.Value AndAlso oModule IsNot DBNull.Value AndAlso currentStatus IsNot DBNull.Value Then Dim sCommand As String = Command.ToString() Dim sModule As String = oModule.ToString() Dim sCurrentStatus As String = currentStatus.ToString() Dim sAction As String = Action.ToString() Dim currentCombination As New Tuple(Of String, String, String)(sCommand, sModule, sCurrentStatus)
'--- Check if other fields that shouldn't be edited are edited If sCommand <> CMDName OrElse sModule <> "UFR" OrElse Action <> "Promote" Then errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Command, Module, and Action cannot be edited. Please try again." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True Return errorResult End If
If Not editedCombinations.Add(currentCombination) Then errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Current Status cannot have the same value twice in workflow. Please change the current status." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True Return errorResult End If
Using dbConn As DbConnInfo = BRApi.Database.CreateDbConnInfo(si, saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.DbLocation, saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.ExternalDBConnName) ' Build the base query Dim sql As String = $"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.TableName} WHERE [Command] = '{sCommand.Replace("'", "''")}' AND [Module] = '{sModule.Replace("'", "''")}' AND [Current_Status] = '{sCurrentStatus.Replace("'", "''")}'"
If editedRow.InsertUpdateOrDelete.ToString() = "Update" Then Dim pkValue As Object = editedRow.OriginalDataRow("Internal_Workflow_Id") ' Change "Id" to your PK column name sql &= $" AND [Internal_Workflow_Id] <> {pkValue}" End If
' Now, execute the query. This works for both Inserts and Updates. Dim count As Integer = 0 Dim resultTable As DataTable = Brapi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConn, sql, True)
If (resultTable IsNot Nothing) AndAlso (resultTable.Rows.Count > 0) Then count = CInt(resultTable.Rows(0)(0)) End If
If count > 0 Then errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Current Status cannot have the same value twice in workflow. Please change the current status." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True Return errorResult End If End Using End If Next
' Return a success result. Dim successResult As New XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult() successResult.IsOK = True Return successResult
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: Save_XFC_CMD_Required_Fields - Save Manage Required Fields table" Private Function Save_XFC_CMD_Required_Fields() As Object Dim saveDataTaskInfo As XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo = args.SqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskInfo Dim saveDataTaskResult As New XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult() Dim errorResult As New XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult()
Dim wfInfoDetails = GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim CMDName As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim WFTimeName As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
Dim editedCombinations As New HashSet(Of Tuple(Of String, String, String, String)) Dim Command As Object Dim Year As Object Dim FieldName As Object Dim oModule As Object Dim Required As Object
For Each editedRow As XFEditedDataRow In saveDataTaskInfo.EditedDataRows If editedRow.InsertUpdateOrDelete.ToString() = "Delete" Then Continue For End If
Command = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("WFCMD_Name") Year = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("WFTime_Name") oModule = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Module") FieldName = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("FieldName") Required = editedRow.ModifiedDataRow("Required")
'--- Check if there are null values for Level, Current Status, and New Status If (FieldName Is DBNull.Value OrElse String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FieldName.ToString())) Then
errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Field Name cannot be blank. Please fill in all required fields before saving." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True
Return errorResult End If
'--- Check if Field Name already exists If FieldName IsNot DBNull.Value AndAlso Command IsNot DBNull.Value AndAlso Year IsNot DBNull.Value AndAlso oModule IsNot DBNull.Value Then Dim sCommand As String = Command.ToString() Dim sModule As String = oModule.ToString() Dim sYear As String = Year.ToString() Dim sFieldName As String = FieldName.ToString() Dim currentCombination As New Tuple(Of String, String, String, String)(sCommand, sModule, sYear, sFieldName)
'--- Check if other fields that shouldn't be edited are edited If sCommand <> CMDName OrElse sYear <> WFTimeName OrElse sModule <> "UFR" Then errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Command, Module, and Year cannot be edited. Please try again." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True Return errorResult End If
If Not editedCombinations.Add(currentCombination) Then errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Field Name cannot have the same value twice in workflow. Please change the Field Name." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True Return errorResult End If
Using dbConn As DbConnInfo = BRApi.Database.CreateDbConnInfo(si, saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.DbLocation, saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.ExternalDBConnName) ' Build the base query Dim sql As String = $"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {saveDataTaskInfo.SqlTableEditorDefinition.TableName} WHERE [WFCMD_Name] = '{sCommand.Replace("'", "''")}' AND [Module] = '{sModule.Replace("'", "''")}' AND [FieldName] = '{sFieldName.Replace("'", "''")}' AND [WFTime_Name] = '{sYear.Replace("'", "''")}'"
If editedRow.InsertUpdateOrDelete.ToString() = "Update" Then Dim pkValue As Object = editedRow.OriginalDataRow("Internal_Required_Id") ' Change "Id" to your PK column name sql &= $" AND [Internal_Required_Id] <> {pkValue}" End If
' Now, execute the query. This works for both Inserts and Updates. Dim count As Integer = 0 Dim resultTable As DataTable = Brapi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConn, sql, True)
If (resultTable IsNot Nothing) AndAlso (resultTable.Rows.Count > 0) Then count = CInt(resultTable.Rows(0)(0)) End If
If count > 0 Then errorResult.IsOK = False errorResult.ShowMessageBox = True errorResult.Message = "Error: Field Name cannot have the same value twice in workflow. Please change the Field Name." errorResult.CancelDefaultSave = True Return errorResult End If End Using End If Next
' Return a success result. Dim successResult As New XFSqlTableEditorSaveDataTaskResult() successResult.IsOK = True Return successResult
End Function #End Region
End Class End Namespace

file.sourceCode:
Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName Public Class CMD_UFR_Utilities Public si As SessionInfo Public globals As BRGlobals Public api As Object Public args As DashboardStringFunctionArgs Public GBL_DataSet As New Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.BusinessRule.DashboardDataSet.GBL_DB_DataSet.MainClass()
Public Shared Function CheckFor_General(ByVal si As SessionInfo, entity As String) As Object 'If the FC is a parent, add _General Dim fundCenter As String = entity Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim membList As List(Of memberinfo) = New List(Of MemberInfo) Dim objDimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "E_" & wfInfoDetails("CMDName")) membList = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, objDimPk, "E#" & fundCenter & ".base", True) If membList.Count > 1 Then fundCenter = fundCenter & "_General" End If Return fundCenter End Function
Public Shared Function GetUD3(ByVal si As SessionInfo, UD1 As String, UD3 As String) As Object '====== Get APPN_FUND And PARENT APPN_L2 ====== Dim U1Name As String = UD1 Dim U1DimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "U1_FundCode") Dim U1MemberID As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMemberId(si,dimType.UD1.Id, U1Name) Dim U1ParentName As String = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetParents(si,U1DimPk, U1MemberId, False, )(0).Name Dim U3Concat As String = U1ParentName & "_" & UD3 Return U3Concat End Function
Public Shared Function GetCopiedRow(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByRef originalRow As DataRow) As Object ' Create a new row with the same schema Dim newRow As DataRow = originalRow.Table.NewRow() newRow.ItemArray = originalRow.ItemArray Return newRow End Function
Public Shared Sub UpdateAuditColumns(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByRef newRow As DataRow) newRow("Create_Date") = DateTime.Now newRow("Create_User") = si.UserName newRow("Update_Date") = DateTime.Now newRow("Update_User") = si.UserName End Sub
Public Shared Function GetProcCtrlVal(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal sEntity As String) As Object Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sScenario As String = ScenarioDimHelper.GetNameFromId(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ScenarioKey) Dim sREQTime As String = BRApi.Finance.Time.GetNameFromId(si,si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim wfProfileName As String = If(wfProfileFullName.Contains("."), wfProfileFullName.Substring(wfProfileFullName.IndexOf(".") + 1).Trim().Split(" "c)(0), String.Empty) Dim counter As Integer = 0 Dim WF_ProcCtrl_Account As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From { {"Formulate","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Creation"}, {"Validate","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Validation"}, {"Staff","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Staff"}, {"Prioritize","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Prioritize"}, {"Approve","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Approve"} } If WF_ProcCtrl_Account.ContainsKey(wfProfileName) Then 'Grab workflow process control value (blank, yes or no) Dim sAllowAccount As String = WF_ProcCtrl_Account(wfProfileName) Dim sAllowAccountMbrScript As String = $"Cb#{sCube}:E#{sEntity}:C#Local:S#RMW_Cycle_Config_Monthly:T#{sREQTime}M12:V#Annotation:A#{sAllowAccount}:F#None:O#BeforeAdj:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None:U8#None" Dim sAllowAccountValue As String = BRApi.Finance.Data.GetDataCellUsingMemberScript(si, sCube, sAllowAccountMbrScript).DataCellEx.DataCellAnnotation 'brapi.ErrorLog.Logmessage(si, $"sAllowAccount: {sAllowAccount} | sAllowAccountValue: {sAllowAccountValue}") If sAllowAccountValue.XFContainsIgnoreCase("no") Then Return "no" Else Return "yes" End If
'Review Step will be blank --> do not want to show functional components on the review steps i.e., formulate requirement component Else If String.IsNullOrEmpty(wfProfileName) Return "no" End If End Function
Public Shared Function GetProcCtrlValMulti(ByVal si As SessionInfo) As Object
Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sScenario As String = ScenarioDimHelper.GetNameFromId(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ScenarioKey) Dim sREQTime As String = BRApi.Finance.Time.GetNameFromId(si,si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim wfProfileName As String = If(wfProfileFullName.Contains("."), wfProfileFullName.Substring(wfProfileFullName.IndexOf(".") + 1).Trim().Split(" "c)(0), String.Empty) Dim counter As Integer = 0 Dim WF_ProcCtrl_Account As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From { {"Formulate","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Creation"}, {"Validate","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Validation"}, {"Staff","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Staff"}, {"Prioritize","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Prioritize"}, {"Approve","CMD_UFR_Allow_Req_Approve"} } If WF_ProcCtrl_Account.ContainsKey(wfProfileName) Then Dim userSecGroup As DataSet = brapi.Dashboards.Process.GetAdoDataSetForAdapter(si,False,"da_GetUserSec","FundsCenterByWF",Nothing) Dim userSecGroup_dt As DataTable = userSecGroup.Tables(0) For Each row As DataRow In userSecGroup_dt.Rows Dim sUserSecEntity = row("Value").ToString Dim sAllowAccount As String = WF_ProcCtrl_Account(wfProfileName) Dim sAllowAccountMbrScript As String = $"Cb#{sCube}:E#{sUserSecEntity}:C#Local:S#RMW_Cycle_Config_Monthly:T#{sREQTime}M12:V#Annotation:A#{sAllowAccount}:F#None:O#BeforeAdj:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None:U8#None" Dim sAllowAccountValue As String = BRApi.Finance.Data.GetDataCellUsingMemberScript(si, sCube, sAllowAccountMbrScript).DataCellEx.DataCellAnnotation If sAllowAccountValue.XFContainsIgnoreCase("no") Then counter += 1 End If Next If counter = userSecGroup_dt.Rows.Count Then Return "no" Else Return "yes" End If End If End Function
End Class End Namespace

Private Sub XFC_CMD_UFR_Details_BulkSync(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal changes As DataTable) ' Start a transaction to ensure either everything saves or nothing saves Using transaction As SqlTransaction = _connection.BeginTransaction() Try Dim createTempSql As String = $"SELECT TOP 0 CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, WFScenario_Name, WFCMD_Name, WFTime_Name, Unit_of_Measure, Entity, IC, Account, Flow, UD1, UD2, UD3, UD4, UD5, UD6, UD7, UD8, AllowUpdate,Create_Date,Create_User,Update_Date,Update_User INTO #Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_Details_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)} FROM XFC_CMD_UFR_Details" Dim createTempIndexSql = $"ALTER TABLE #Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_Details_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)} ADD PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Account, CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, Entity, IC, UD1, UD2, UD3, UD4, UD5, UD6, UD7, UD8)" Using cmd As New SqlCommand(createTempSql, _connection, transaction) cmd.ExecuteNonQuery() cmd.CommandText = createTempIndexSql cmd.ExecuteNonQuery() End Using
Using bulkCopy As New SqlBulkCopy(_connection, SqlBulkCopyOptions.Default, transaction) bulkCopy.DestinationTableName = $"#Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_Details_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)}" bulkCopy.WriteToServer(changes) End Using
Dim mergeSql As String = $"MERGE INTO XFC_CMD_UFR_Details AS Target USING #Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_Details_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)} AS Source ON Target.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = Source.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No AND Target.Account = Source.Account AND Target.Entity = Source.Entity AND Target.IC = Source.IC AND Target.UD1 = Source.UD1 AND Target.UD2 = Source.UD2 AND Target.UD3 = Source.UD3 AND Target.UD4 = Source.UD4 AND Target.UD5 = Source.UD5 AND Target.UD6 = Source.UD6 AND Target.UD7 = Source.UD7 AND Target.UD8 = Source.UD8
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Target.WFScenario_Name = Source.WFScenario_Name, Target.WFCMD_Name = Source.WFCMD_Name, Target.WFTime_Name = Source.WFTime_Name, Target.Unit_of_Measure = Source.Unit_of_Measure, Target.Flow = Source.Flow, Target.AllowUpdate = Source.AllowUpdate, Target.Update_Date = GETDATE(), Target.Update_User = @UserName
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT ( CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, WFScenario_Name, WFCMD_Name, WFTime_Name, Unit_of_Measure, Entity, IC, Account, Flow, UD1, UD2, UD3, UD4, UD5, UD6, UD7, UD8, AllowUpdate, Create_Date, Create_User, Update_Date, Update_User ) VALUES ( Source.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, Source.WFScenario_Name, Source.WFCMD_Name, Source.WFTime_Name, Source.Unit_of_Measure, Source.Entity, Source.IC, Source.Account, Source.Flow, Source.UD1, Source.UD2, Source.UD3, Source.UD4, Source.UD5, Source.UD6, Source.UD7, Source.UD8, Source.AllowUpdate, GETDATE(), @UserName, GETDATE(), @UserName );" Using mergeCmd As New SqlCommand(mergeSql, _connection, transaction) mergeCmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserName", si.UserName) mergeCmd.ExecuteNonQuery() End Using CaptureAudit(changes, transaction, "import") transaction.Commit() Catch ex As Exception transaction.Rollback() Throw New XFException($"Bulk Sync Failed: {ex.Message}", ex) End Try End Using End Sub

Private Sub XFC_CMD_UFR_BulkSync(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal changes As DataTable) ' Start a transaction to ensure either everything saves or nothing saves Using transaction As SqlTransaction = _connection.BeginTransaction() Try Dim createTempSql As String = $"SELECT TOP 0 CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, WFScenario_Name, WFCMD_Name, WFTime_Name, Title, UFR_ID, REQ_Link_ID, Description, Entity, Review_Entity, ROC, APPN, SAG_SSN, MDEP, APE9, Dollar_Type, Obj_Class, CType, Command_UFR_Status, MustFund, Create_Date, Create_User, Update_Date, Update_User INTO #Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)} FROM XFC_CMD_UFR" Using cmd As New SqlCommand(createTempSql, _connection, transaction) cmd.ExecuteNonQuery() End Using
'Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,$"Hit Sync req: {changes.Rows.Count}") ' 2. Use SqlBulkCopy to stream the changes to the #Temp table Using bulkCopy As New SqlBulkCopy(_connection, SqlBulkCopyOptions.Default, transaction) bulkCopy.DestinationTableName = $"#Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)}" bulkCopy.WriteToServer(changes) End Using ' We use the GUID column as the unique identifier for the join Dim mergeSql As String = $"MERGE INTO XFC_CMD_UFR AS Target USING #Temp_XFC_CMD_UFR_{StringHelper.ReplaceString(si.AuthToken.AuthSessionID.ToString(),"-","_",True)} AS Source ON Target.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = Source.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET Target.APE9 = Source.APE9, Target.APPN = Source.APPN, Target.SAG_SSN = Source.SAG_SSN, Target.Title = Source.Title, Target.UFR_ID = Source.UFR_ID, Target.REQ_Link_ID = Source.UFR_ID, Target.Description = Source.Description, Target.Dollar_Type = Source.Dollar_Type, Target.Entity = Source.Entity, Target.Review_Entity = Source.Review_Entity, Target.ROC = Source.ROC, Target.MDEP = Source.MDEP, Target.Obj_Class = Source.Obj_Class, Target.Command_UFR_Status = Source.Command_UFR_Status, Target.MustFund = Source.MustFund, Target.WFCMD_Name = Source.WFCMD_Name, Target.WFScenario_Name = Source.WFScenario_Name, Target.WFTime_Name = Source.WFTime_Name, Target.Update_Date = GETDATE(), Target.Update_User = @UserName
WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET THEN INSERT (CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, WFScenario_Name, WFCMD_Name, WFTime_Name, Title, UFR_ID, REQ_Link_ID, Description, Entity, APPN, SAG_SSN, MDEP, APE9, Dollar_Type, Obj_Class, CType, Command_UFR_Status, MustFund, Create_User, Create_Date, Update_User, Update_Date, Review_Entity, ROC) VALUES (Source.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No, Source.WFScenario_Name, Source.WFCMD_Name, Source.WFTime_Name, Source.Title, Source.UFR_ID, Source.REQ_Link_ID, Source.Description, Source.Entity, Source.APPN, Source.SAG_SSN, Source.MDEP, Source.APE9, Source.Dollar_Type, Source.Obj_Class, Source.CType, Source.Command_UFR_Status, Source.MustFund, @UserName, GETDATE(), @UserName, GETDATE(), Source.Review_Entity, Source.ROC);"
Using mergeCmd As New SqlCommand(mergeSql, _connection, transaction) mergeCmd.Parameters.AddWithValue("@UserName", si.UserName) mergeCmd.ExecuteNonQuery() End Using
CaptureAudit(changes, transaction, "import") transaction.Commit()
Catch ex As Exception transaction.Rollback() Throw New XFException($"Bulk Sync Failed: {ex.Message}", ex) End Try End Using End Sub

Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800 Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName.BusinessRule.DashboardStringFunction.CMD_UFR_String_Helper Public Class MainClass Public si As SessionInfo Public globals As BRGlobals Public api As Object Public args As DashboardStringFunctionArgs
Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As Object, ByVal args As DashboardStringFunctionArgs) As Object Try Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.api = api Me.args = args Select Case args.FunctionName.ToLower() Case "showhide" Return Me.ShowHide() ' Return Me.ShowHideLabel() ' Case "showhidelabelmulti" ' Return Me.ShowHideLabelMulti() Case "procctrllblmsg" Return Me.ProcCtrlLblMsg() Case "procctrllblmsgmulti" Return Me.ProcCtrlLblMsgMulti() Case "reqretrievecache" Return Me.REQRetrieveCache() Case "showhidenarrative" Return Me.ShowHideNarrative() Case "dynnarrativedashboard" Return Me.DynNarrartiveDashboard() Case "dynsharedheaderdashboard" Return Me.DynSharedHeaderDashboard() Case "dynsharedheaderdashboardformulate" Return Me.DynSharedHeaderDashboardFormulate() Case "dynsessionretrieve" Return Me.DynSessionRetrieve() Case "columnnameparamhelper" Return Me.ColumnNameParamHelper() Case "dynstaffbtnvisibility" Return Me.DynStaffBtnVisibility() Case "dynstaffbtnname" Return Me.DynStaffBtnName() Case "showhidenarrativexftv" Return Me.ShowHideNarrativeXFTV() Case "retrievepbposition" Return Me.RetrievePBPosition() Case "retrievegeneralcomments" Return Me.RetrieveGeneralComments() Case "createlbltext" Return Me.createlbltext() Case "getufrtrackingnum" Return Me.getufrtrackingnum() Case "retrievefundscenterlevel" Return Me.RetrieveFundsCenterLevel() Case "retrieveid" Return Me.RetrieveID() Case "retrievedynbtnfmt" Return Me.RetrieveDynBtnFmt() Case "retrievemanageadminfcs" Return Me.RetrieveManageAdminFCs()
End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw New XFException(si, ex) End Try End Function
#Region "Constants" Public GBL_Helper As New Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.BusinessRule.DashboardExtender.GBL_Helper.MainClass Public GBL_DataSet As New Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.BusinessRule.DashboardDataSet.GBL_DB_DataSet.MainClass() #End Region
#Region "getufrtrackingnum" Public Function getufrtrackingnum() As Object Dim UFRID = Brapi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "REQRetrieve", "ReqIDs", "") Dim WFInfoDetails As New Dictionary(Of String, String)() Dim wfInitInfo = BRApi.Workflow.General.GetUserWorkflowInitInfo(si) Dim wfUnitInfo = wfInitInfo.GetSelectedWorkflowUnitInfo() Dim wfCubeRootInfo = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si,wfUnitInfo.ProfileName) WFInfoDetails.Add("ProfileName", wfUnitInfo.ProfileName) WFInfoDetails.Add("ScenarioName", wfUnitInfo.ScenarioName) WFInfoDetails.Add("TimeName", wfUnitInfo.TimeName) WFInfoDetails.Add("CMDName", wfCubeRootInfo.CubeName) Dim sUFR_ID_Val As String = String.Empty Dim UFR_ID_Val_guid As Guid = Guid.Empty Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open() ' --- Main Request Table (XFC_CMD_PGM_REQ_CMT) --- Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim sqaReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_UFR(sqlConn) 'Dim ReqID As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("REQ")
If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(UFRID) Return Nothing Else 'Fill the DataTable Dim sql As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_UFR WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name AND UFR_ID = @UFR_ID"
' 2. Create a list to hold the parameters Dim sqlParams As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter(){ New SqlParameter("@WFScenario_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFCMD_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFTime_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}, New SqlParameter("@UFR_ID", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = UFRID} } sqaReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_UFR_DT(sqa,dt,sql, sqlparams)
If dt.Rows.Count > 0 Then 'sREQ_ID_Val = Convert.ToString(dt.Rows(0)("CMD_PGM_REQ_ID")) UFR_ID_Val_guid = dt.Rows(0)("CMD_UFR_Tracking_No") Else Return Nothing End If End If End Using End Using 'Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "REQ ID" & REQ_ID_Val_guid.ToString()) Return UFR_ID_Val_guid End Function
#End Region
#Region "CreateLblText" Public Function CreateLblText() As String Dim sLabelName As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("LabelName") Dim sEntity_REQID As String = Brapi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "REQRetrieve", "ReqIDs", "") Dim wfCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim SQL As String Dim dt As New DataTable 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"sEntity_REQID: {sEntity_REQID}") Select Case sLabelName Case "PromotionList" Dim dPromotionList As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From { {"Staff","Staffers"}, {"Validate","Validators"}, {"Prioritize","Prioritizers"}, {"Approve","Approvers"}, {"ReviewABO","ABO Reviewers"} } Dim dbConnApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using connection As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) connection.Open() SQL = $"SELECT t1.Command_UFR_Status As CurrentStatus, t2.New_Status As NewStatus FROM [XFC_CMD_UFR] As t1 INNER JOIN [XFC_CMD_MG_Workflow] As t2 ON t2.Current_Status LIKE t1.Command_UFR_Status WHERE t1.UFR_ID LIKE '%{sEntity_REQID}%' AND t2.Command LIKE '%{wfCube}%'" dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp, SQL, True) 'End Using Dim NewStatus As String = dt.Rows(0)("NewStatus").ToString If String.IsNullOrEmpty(NewStatus) Then Return "No Available Users to Notify - Please contact your Manager." Else Return dPromotionList(NewStatus.Split("_"c)(1)) End If 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"NewStatus: {NewStatus} || NewStatusRole: {NewStatusRole}") End Using Case "DemoteLbl" Return $"{sEntity_REQID}"
End Select End Function #End Region
#Region "ShowHide" 'Purpose: Any component, cv, object etc., add a case statment 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"sComponentName {sComponentName}") Public Function ShowHide() As String Dim sEntity = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("entity") Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sScenario As String = ScenarioDimHelper.GetNameFromId(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ScenarioKey) Dim sREQTime As String = BRApi.Finance.Time.GetNameFromId(si,si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim sComponentName As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("ComponentName") 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"Entity: {sEntity} || wfProfileFullName: {wfProfileFullName} || sComponentName: {sComponentName}") 'Manpower Specific Dim sREQ_ID As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("UFR_ID")
If GBL_Helpers.IsSupportRole(si) Then Return "False"
#Region "Workflow complete and revert buttons" Select Case sComponentName Case "WorkflowAccess" If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Manage CMD UFR") Then Return "True" Else Return "False" End If Case "ABO" If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase(".") Or wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("ABO") Then Return "True" Else Return "False" End If ' Case "demote" ''brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "inside demote case statement") ' If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Formulate") Then ' Return "False" ' Else ' Return "True" ' End If End Select #End Region 'Grab workflow status (locked or unlocked) Dim deArgs As New DashboardExtenderArgs deArgs.FunctionName = "Check_WF_Complete_Lock" Dim sWFStatus As String = GBL_Helper.Main(si, globals, api, deArgs)
'Grab process control value for an entity + workflow profile Dim sProcCtrlVal As String = CMD_UFR_Utilities.GetProcCtrlVal(si,sEntity)
If sProcCtrlVal.XFContainsIgnoreCase("no") Or sWFStatus.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("locked") Then Return "False" End If
Select Case sComponentName Case Else Return "True" End Select End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: REQRetrieveCache" Public Function REQRetrieveCache() Try Dim sEntity As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"REQPrompts","Entity","") Dim sREQToDelete As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"REQPrompts","REQ","") Dim cachedREQ As String = sREQToDelete Return cachedREQ Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex))
End Try
End Function
#End Region
#Region "Function: DynSessionRetrieve" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, DynSessionRetrieve, RetrievalType=[]) Public Function DynSessionRetrieve() Try Dim sRetrievalType As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("RetrievalType") Dim result As String = String.Empty Dim sFormulateDashboard As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"GenericRetrieve","FormulateDashboard","") Dim sUFRList As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"REQRetrieve","ReqIDs","")
' If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sUFRList) Then Return Nothing ' BRAPI.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Dynamic Session Get REQ ID = " & sUFRList)
Select Case sRetrievalType Case "FormulateDashboard" result = sFormulateDashboard Case "UFRSelection" ' BRAPI.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Dynamic Session Get REQ ID = " & sUFRList) result = sUFRList
End Select Return result
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
#End Region
#Region "Function: ShowHideNarrative - Tabs/Buttons" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, ShowHideNarrative, WFLevel=[]) Public Function ShowHideNarrative() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim WorkflowLevel As String = args.NameValuePairs("WFLevel") Dim showButton As String = "IsVisible = True" Dim hideButton As String = "IsVisible = False" Dim result As String
If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("CMD") Then If WorkflowLevel = "CMD" Then result = showButton Else result = hideButton End If Else If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("HQ") Then If WorkflowLevel = "HQ" Then result = showButton Else result = hideButton End If End If
Return result
'Grab workflow status (locked or unlocked) ' Dim deArgs As New DashboardExtenderArgs ' deArgs.FunctionName = "Check_WF_Complete_Lock" ' Dim sWFStatus As String = GBL_Helper.Main(si, globals, api, deArgs)
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: ShowHideNarrativeXFTV - Show or Hide Staff Element XFTV" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, ShowHideNarrativeXFTV) Public Function ShowHideNarrativeXFTV() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim sShowStaffXFTV As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "Staffing", "StaffSelection", "") Dim result As String ' Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "sShowStaffXFTV = " & sShowStaffXFTV) If sShowStaffXFTV.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("G3 Staff") AndAlso Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Sub") AndAlso Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("HQ") Then result = "CMD_UFR_1c2b_DynBody_UFRDetailWithStaffNarrative_G3" Else If sShowStaffXFTV.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("G3/5/7 HQ Staff") result = "CMD_UFR_1c2c_DynBody_UFRDetailWithStaffNarrative_G357" ' Else If sShowStaffXFTV.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("ABO HQ Staff") ' result = "CMD_UFR_1c2d_DynBody_UFRDetailWithStaffNarrative_ABO" Else result = "CMD_UFR_1c2a_DynBody_UFRDetailWithStaffNarrative_General" End If ' brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, " ShowHidNarrativeXFTV Result = " & result) Return result
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: DynNarrativeDashboard - Dynamic Narrative Dashboard" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, DynNarrativeDashboard) Public Function DynNarrartiveDashboard() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim result As String = String.Empty
' If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Staff") Or wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Validate HQ UFR") Or wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("ABO Review (ABO UFR)") Then If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Staff") Or wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Validate HQ UFR") Then result = "CMD_UFR_1c_Body_UFRDynStaffing" Else result = "CMD_UFR_1c_Body_UFRDynNoStaffing" End If
Return result
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: DynSharedHeaderDashboard - Dynamic Formulate Dashboard Header" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, DynSharedHeaderDashboard) Public Function DynSharedHeaderDashboard() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim result As String = String.Empty
If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Formulate") result = "CMD_UFR_2a_Header_Dyn_Formulate" Else result = "CMD_UFR_2b_Header_Dyn_Other" End If
Return result
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: DynSharedHeaderDashboardFormulate - Dynamic Formulate Dashboard Header Formulate" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, DynSharedHeaderDashboardFormulate, Dashboard = []) Public Function DynSharedHeaderDashboardFormulate() As String Dim result As String = String.Empty Dim sDashboard As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("Dashboard")
If sDashboard = "CMD_UFR_2a1_Header_Dyn_Formulate" result = "CMD_UFR_2a1_Header_Dyn_Formulate" Else result = "CMD_UFR_2a2_Header_Dyn_Formulate" End If
Return result
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: ColumnNameParamHelper - Column Name Parameter Helper - HQ vs Command selecting dropdown list" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, ColumnNameParamHelper) Public Function ColumnNameParamHelper() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim result As String = String.Empty
If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("HQ") result = "BL_CMD_UFR_Column_Name" Else If wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("CMD") result = "BL_CMD_UFR_Column_Name_CommandLevel" End If
Return result
End Function
#End Region
#Region "Function: DynStaffBtnVisibility - Dynamic Staff Visibility Btn Formatting - Visibility true or false based on user security" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, DynStaffBtnVisibility, BtnNo=[]) Public Function DynStaffBtnVisibility() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim sDynBtnNo As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("BtnNo") Dim iBtnNo As Integer = 0
Integer.TryParse(sDynBtnNo, iBtnNo)
Dim result As String = ""
Dim sUserName As String = si.AuthToken.UserName Dim sSecurityGroup As String = "g_UFR_ST_%" Dim sgSQL As String = String.Empty
sgSQL = $"SELECT --SG.UniqueID as GroupID, --SG.Name as AccessGroup SG.Description As Description FROM SecUser as u JOIN SecGroupChild AS GRP1 on GRP1.ChildKey = u.uniqueid JOIN SecGroup AS SG on sg.UniqueID = GRP1.GroupKey WHERE U.Name = '{sUserName}' AND SG.Name LIKE '{sSecurityGroup}' ORDER BY SG.Description "
Dim dtAll As New DataTable Using dbConn As DbConnInfo = Brapi.Database.CreateFrameworkDbConnInfo(si) dtAll = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConn, sgSQL, True) End Using
Dim staffList As New List(Of String)
For Each row As DataRow In dtAll.Rows If Not IsDBNull(row(0)) Then Dim rawValue As String = row(0).ToString()
Dim cleanValue As String = rawValue.Split("_"c)(0).Trim() If cleanValue <> "" Then staffList.Add(cleanValue) End If Next
If staffList.Count < iBtnNo Then result = "IsVisible = False" End If
' If Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Staff") AndAlso Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Validate HQ UFR") AndAlso Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("ABO Review (ABO UFR)") Then If Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Staff") AndAlso Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Validate HQ UFR") Then result = "IsVisible = False" End If Return result
End Function
#End Region
#Region "Function: DynStaffBtnName - Dynamic Staff Name Btn Formatting - Name of each staff element assigned to user" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, DynStaffBtnName, BtnNo=[]) Public Function DynStaffBtnName() As String Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim sDynBtnNo As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("BtnNo") Dim iBtnNo As Integer = 0
Integer.TryParse(sDynBtnNo, iBtnNo) Dim iIndex As Integer = iBtnNo - 1 Dim result As String = ""
Dim sUserName As String = si.AuthToken.UserName Dim sSecurityGroup As String = "g_UFR_ST_%" Dim sgSQL As String = String.Empty
sgSQL = $"SELECT --SG.UniqueID as GroupID, --SG.Name as AccessGroup SG.Description As Description FROM SecUser as u JOIN SecGroupChild AS GRP1 on GRP1.ChildKey = u.uniqueid JOIN SecGroup AS SG on sg.UniqueID = GRP1.GroupKey WHERE U.Name = '{sUserName}' AND SG.Name LIKE '{sSecurityGroup}' ORDER BY SG.Description "
Dim dtAll As New DataTable Using dbConn As DbConnInfo = Brapi.Database.CreateFrameworkDbConnInfo(si) dtAll = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConn, sgSQL, True) End Using
Dim staffList As New List(Of String)
For Each row As DataRow In dtAll.Rows If Not IsDBNull(row(0)) Then Dim rawValue As String = row(0).ToString()
Dim cleanValue As String = rawValue.Split("_"c)(0).Trim() If cleanValue <> "" Then staffList.Add(cleanValue) End If Next
If iIndex >=0 AndAlso iIndex < staffList.Count Then result = staffList(iIndex) End If
' Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Result = " & result) Return result
End Function
#End Region
#Region "Function: - RetrievePBPosition" Public Function RetrievePBPosition() As String Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sAllowAccountMbrScript As String = $"Cb#Army:E#Army:C#Local:S#|WFScenario|:T#|WFTime|M1:V#Annotation:A#Var_Selected_Position:F#None:O#BeforeAdj:I#None:U1#None:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None:U8#None" Dim sPBPosition As String = BRApi.Finance.Data.GetDataCellUsingMemberScript(si, sCube, sAllowAccountMbrScript).DataCellEx.DataCellAnnotation If String.IsNullOrEmpty(sPBPosition) Then Return "A PB Position has not be defined for |WFScenario|. Please contact your manager." Else Return sPBPosition End If End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: - RetriveGeneralComments" Public Function RetrieveGeneralComments() As String Dim ReqID As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"REQRetrieve","ReqIDs","")
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: - RetrieveFundsCenterLevel" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, RetrieveFundsCenterLevel) Public Function RetrieveFundsCenterLevel() As String Dim sEntity As String = args.CustomSubstVars.XFGetValue("BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter","") If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sEntity) Then Return Nothing Dim sLevel As String = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetEntityLevel(si, sEntity) Return sLevel End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: RetrieveID - Retrieve a new ID for the Comment table or the Attachment table" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, RetrieveID, Table=[]) Public Function RetrieveID() As String Dim sTable As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("Table") Dim NewID As Guid = Guid.NewGuid() Dim settingKey As String = $"RetrieveID_{sTable.Trim()}"
BRApi.Utilities.SetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, settingKey, "retrieveTableID", NewID.ToString) Dim resultID As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, settingKey, "retrieveTableID", "") resultID = resultID.XFConvertToInt Return resultID End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: RetrieveDynBtnFmt - Retrieve Dynamic Button Format for button clicked" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, RetrieveDynBtnFmt, BtnNo=[]) Public Function RetrieveDynBtnFmt() As String Dim sBtnNoRaw As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("BtnNo") Dim clickedBtnNoRaw As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "StaffBtnFormat", "BtnNo", "") Dim sBtnNo As Integer = Convert.ToInt32(sBtnNoRaw) Dim clickedBtnColor As String = "BackgroundColor = XFDarkBlueBackground" Dim NonClickedBtnColor As String = "BackgroundColor = XFLightGray" Dim result As String = String.Empty Dim clickedBtnNo As Integer
If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(clickedBtnNoRaw) Then clickedBtnNo = 100 Else clickedBtnNo = Convert.ToInt32(clickedBtnNoRaw) End If
If clickedBtnNo = sBtnNo Then Return clickedBtnColor Else Return NonClickedBtnColor End If
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: RetrieveManageAdminFCs - Retrieve the managed funds Centers for the Admin Dashboard" 'XFBR(Workspace.Current.CMD_UFR_Assembly.CMD_UFR_String_Helper, RetrieveManageAdminFCs, Entity=[|!BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter!|]) Public Function RetrieveManageAdminFCs() As String Dim wfProfileName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim sEntity As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("Entity") Dim result As String = String.Empty
If wfProfileName.XFContainsIgnoreCase(".Manage CMD UFR") Or wfProfileName.XFContainsIgnoreCase(".Manage HQ UFR") Then result = $"E#{sEntity}.ChildrenInclusive.Where(Name DoesNotContain General)" Else result = $"E#{sEntity}.Children.Where(Name DoesNotContain General)" End If
Return result End Function #End Region
#Region "ProcCtrlLblMsg" 'Purpose: Any component, cv, object etc., add a case statment 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"sComponentName {sComponentName}") Public Function ProcCtrlLblMsg() As String Dim sEntity = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("entity") Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim wfProfileName As String = If(wfProfileFullName.Contains("."), wfProfileFullName.Substring(wfProfileFullName.IndexOf(".") + 1).Trim().Split(" "c)(0), String.Empty)
Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim deArgs As New DashboardExtenderArgs deArgs.FunctionName = "Check_WF_Complete_Lock" Dim sWFStatus As String = GBL_Helper.Main(si, globals, api, deArgs)
'Grab process control value for an entity + workflow profile Dim sProcCtrlVal As String = CMD_UFR_Utilities.GetProcCtrlVal(si,sEntity) sEntity = If(sEntity.Contains("_"), sEntity.Substring(0, sEntity.IndexOf("_")), sEntity)
If sWFStatus.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("locked") Then Return $"The CMD manager locked all workflow steps for {sCube}. {vbCrLf}No further work can be completed at this time." Else If sProcCtrlVal.XFContainsIgnoreCase("no") Then
Select Case wfProfileName Case "Formulate" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be formulated or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access."
Case "Prioritize" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be prioritized or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access."
Case "Validate" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be validated or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access."
Case "Staff" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be staffed at this time.. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access."
Case "Approve" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be approved at this time.. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access." End Select End If End Function #End Region
#Region "ProcCtrlLblMsgMulti" 'Purpose: Any component, cv, object etc., add a case statment 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"sComponentName {sComponentName}") Public Function ProcCtrlLblMsgMulti() As String Dim sEntity = String.Empty Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim wfProfileName As String = If(wfProfileFullName.Contains("."), wfProfileFullName.Substring(wfProfileFullName.IndexOf(".") + 1).Trim().Split(" "c)(0), String.Empty) Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim deArgs As New DashboardExtenderArgs deArgs.FunctionName = "Check_WF_Complete_Lock" Dim sWFStatus As String = GBL_Helper.Main(si, globals, api, deArgs) 'Grab process control value for an entity + workflow profile Dim sProcCtrlVal As String = CMD_UFR_Utilities.GetProcCtrlValMulti(si) Dim userSecGroup As DataSet = brapi.Dashboards.Process.GetAdoDataSetForAdapter(si,False,"da_GetUserSec","FundsCenterByWF",Nothing) Dim userSecGroup_dt As DataTable = userSecGroup.Tables(0)
If sWFStatus.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("locked") Then Return $"The CMD manager locked all workflow steps for {sCube}. {vbCrLf}No further work can be completed at this time."
Else If sProcCtrlVal.XFContainsIgnoreCase("no") Then 'Build list of entities a user is assigned to and diaplay them in the label message. For Each row As DataRow In userSecGroup_dt.Rows Dim sUserSecEntity = row("Value").ToString sUserSecEntity = If(sUserSecEntity.Contains("_"), sUserSecEntity.Substring(0, sUserSecEntity.IndexOf("_")), sEntity) If String.IsNullOrEmpty(sEntity) Then sEntity = sUserSecEntity Else sEntity = sEntity & ", " & sUserSecEntity End If Next
Select Case wfProfileName Case "Formulate" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be formulated or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access." Case "Staff" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be staffed or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access." Case "Validate" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be validated or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access." Case "Prioritize" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be prioritized or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access." Case "Approve" Return $"Your manager locked the {wfProfileName} step for {sEntity}. {vbCrLf}Requirements cannot be approved or modified at this time. {vbCrLf}Please contact your manager to allow access." End Select End If End Function #End Region End Class End Namespace

Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports System.Text.Json Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800 Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName.BusinessRule.Spreadsheet.CMD_UFR_REQ_ID_XFTV Public Class MainClass ' Global variables Private si As SessionInfo Private globals As BRGlobals Private api As Object Private args As SpreadsheetArgs ' Private ParamsToClear As String
Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As Object, ByVal args As SpreadsheetArgs) As Object
' Assign to global variables Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.api = api Me.args = args ' Me.ParamsToClear = ParamsToClear Try Select Case args.FunctionType Case SpreadsheetFunctionType.GetCustomSubstVarsInUse ' Return New List(Of String)() Dim custSubstVars As New List(Of String) Return custSubstVars Case SpreadsheetFunctionType.GetTableView If args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved IsNot Nothing Then Dim json As String = JsonSerializer.Serialize(args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved) Dim bytes As Byte() = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json) BRApi.State.SetSessionState(si, False, ClientModuleType.Unknown, GetType(Dictionary(Of String, String)).Name, String.Empty, "SubstVars", si.UserName, String.Empty, bytes) Else BRApi.State.SetSessionState(si, False, ClientModuleType.Unknown, GetType(Dictionary(Of String, String)).Name, String.Empty, "SubstVars", si.UserName, String.Empty, Nothing) End If
Dim SubstVars_List As New List(Of String)
If args.TableViewName = "Create_New_UFR" Return Get_Create_New_UFR() End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info" Return Get_UFR_Base_Info() End If
If args.TableViewName = "Copy_New_UFR" Return Get_Copy_New_UFR() End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_Staffing_Elements" Return Get_UFR_Base_Info_Staffing_Params("Primary_Staff") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_Army_Campaign_Objectives" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("Army Campaign Objectives") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_Command_UFR_Priority" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("Command_UFR_Priority") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_Initial_Review_Type" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("Initial_Review_Type") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_UFR_Driver" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("UFR_Driver") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_UFR_Type" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("UFR_Type") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_FF_4" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("FF_4") End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info_Param_FF_5" Return Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params("FF_5") End If
If args.TableViewName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("UFR_Staffing_Narrative") Return Get_UFR_Staffing_Narrative() End If
Case SpreadsheetFunctionType.SaveTableView Dim uState = BRApi.State.GetSessionState(si, False, ClientModuleType.Unknown, GetType(Dictionary(Of String, String)).Name, String.Empty, "SubstVars", si.UserName) If uState IsNot Nothing Then Dim jsonString As String = System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(uState.BinaryValue) args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(Of Dictionary(Of String, String))(jsonString) End If
If args.TableViewName = "Create_New_UFR" Return Save_Create_New_UFR() End If
If args.TableViewName = "UFR_Base_Info" Dim ReqID As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"REQRetrieve","ReqIDs","") If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ReqID) Then Return Nothing Return Save_UFR_Base_Info() End If
If args.TableViewName = "Copy_New_UFR" Return Save_Copy_New_UFR() End If
If args.TableViewName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("UFR_Staffing_Narrative") Return Save_UFR_Staffing_Narrative() End If
Case Else Return Nothing End Select Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
' --- XFTV Helper Functions --- #Region "XFTV Helpers" #Region "Get Entity Level" Public Function GetEntityLevel(sEntity As String) As String Dim entityMem As Member = BRApi.Finance.Metadata.GetMember(si, DimType.Entity.Id, sEntity).Member Dim wfScenarioTypeID As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Scenario.GetScenarioType(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ScenarioKey).Id Dim wfTime As String = BRApi.Finance.Time.GetNameFromId(si,si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim wfTimeId As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMemberId(si,DimType.Time.Id,wfTime)
Dim level As String = String.Empty Dim entityText3 As String = BRApi.Finance.Entity.Text(si, entityMem.MemberId, 3, wfScenarioTypeID, wfTimeId) If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entityText3) AndAlso entityText3.StartsWith("EntityLevel") Then level = entityText3.Substring(entityText3.Length -2, 2) End If
Return level
End Function #End Region
#End Region
' --- Call Functions ---
#Region "Create_New_UFR" #Region "Function: Get_Create_New_UFR - Create New UFR" Private Function Get_Create_New_UFR() As TableView Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim xftv As New TableView() xftv.CanModifyData = True xftv.NumberOfEmptyRowsToAdd = 1 xftv.EmptyRowsBackgroundColor = XFColors.AliceBlue Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim sql As String = $"SELECT Req.[Army_Campaign_Objectives], Req.[Initial_Review_Type], Req.[CMD_UFR_Tracking_No], Req.[Command_UFR_Priority], Req.[Command_UFR_Status], Req.[Create_Date], Req.[Create_User], Req.[Date_Decision_Needed_By], Req.[Description], Req.[Fund_Type], Req.[Funds_Required_By], Req.[MustFund], Req.[PEG], Req.[Study_Category], Req.[RDA_UFR_Executable_Fund_Year], Req.[RDA_UFR_FY_New_Start], Req.[Requirement_Background], Req.[Review_Entity], Req.[Review_Staff], Req.[REQ_Link_ID], Req.[ROC], Req.[Rollover_To_Next_UFR_Cycle], Req.[SAG_SSN], Req.[Solicited_NonSolicited], Req.[UFR_Capability_GAP], Req.[UFR_Capability_GAP_If_CMD_Fund], Req.[UFR_Driver], Req.[UFR_Driver_Explanation], Req.[UFR_ID], Req.[UFR_ID_Type], Req.[Update_Date], Req.[Update_User], Req.[WFCMD_Name], Req.[WFScenario_Name], Req.[WFTime_Name], Req.[FF_1], Req.[FF_2], Req.[FF_3], Req.[FF_4], Req.[FF_5], Req.[Gen_Comments_Notes], --STRING_AGG(Att.Attach_File_Name, ', ') AS Attach_File_Name Att.Attach_File_Name FROM XFC_CMD_UFR AS Req LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR_Attachment AS Att -- Assuming the attachment table name changes to match the new UFR table ON Req.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = Att.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No -- Joining on the new PK WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}' AND WFCMD_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}' AND WFTime_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}' AND 1 <> 1 "
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp,sql,False) End Using
xftv.PopulateFromDataTable(dt,True,True)
Return xftv End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: Save_Create_New_UFR - Save Create New UFR" Public Function Save_Create_New_UFR() As Object Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim xftv As TableView = args.TableView Dim sEntity As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter") Dim sU1APPNInput As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateAPPN") Dim sU2Input As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateMDEP") Dim sU3Input As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateAPEPT") Dim sU4Input As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateDollarType") Dim sU5Input As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateCType") Dim sU6Input As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateObjectClass") Dim sSAGInput As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("ML_CMD_UFR_FormulateSAG") Dim UFR_ID As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "FormulateUFR", "UFR_ID", String.Empty) Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sWFYear As String = TimeDimHelper.GetYearFromId(si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim U3DimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "U3_SAG") Dim U3List As List(Of MemberInfo) = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, U3DimPk, "U3#" & sSAGInput & ".Ancestors.Where(MemberDim = U3_BA)", True) Dim sBAInput As String = U3List(0).Member.Name 'Clean the values Dim sSAG As String = sSAGInput.Split("_"c)(1) Dim sBA As String = sBAInput.Split("_"c)(1) Dim sTime As String = sWFYear.Substring(2) ' Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"XFTV - SettingNameString = {UFR_ID} - {sEntity} - {sU1APPNInput} - {sU2Input} - {sU3Input} - {sU4Input} - {sU5Input} - {sU6Input}") Dim NewReqID As String = GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetNewUFRGuidCopy(Me.si, UFR_ID, sEntity, sU1APPNInput, sU2Input, sU3Input, sU4Input, sU5Input, sU6Input, sSAGInput)
Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si)
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open() Dim sqaReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_UFR(sqlConn) Dim Sql As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_UFR WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name" Dim sqlparams As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() { New SqlParameter("@WFScenario_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFCMD_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFTime_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")} } sqaReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_UFR_DT(sqa, dt, Sql, sqlparams) For Each xftvRow As TableViewRow In xftv.Rows.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsHeader) Try Dim targetRow As DataRow targetRow = dt.Select($"CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = '{NewReqID.xfconverttoGUID}'").FirstOrDefault() Dim isInsert As Boolean = False
Dim dtGetFundsCenterStaffing As DataTable = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetFundsCenterStaffing(si, globals, api, sEntity) Dim secondaryStaff As String = String.Empty Dim reviewStaff As String = xftvRow.Item("Review_Staff").Value For Each staffRow As DataRow In dtGetFundsCenterStaffing.Rows If staffRow("Primary_Staff").ToString().Equals(reviewStaff, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
If Not IsDBNull(staffRow("Secondary_Staff")) AndAlso staffRow("Secondary_Staff").ToString().Trim() <> "" Then secondaryStaff = staffRow("Secondary_Staff").ToString() Exit For End If End If Next
targetRow("Secondary_Review_Staff") = secondaryStaff
' Iterate each column/cell in the XFTV row and apply dirty changes to the DataRow ' Make a copy of the keys to avoid collection modification issues Dim dirtyColList As List(Of String) = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_XFTV_Helpers.Dirty_Column_List(si,xftvRow) For Each colName As String In dirtyColList targetRow(colName) = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_XFTV_Helpers.Convert_xftvCol_to_DbValue(si, xftvRow.Item(colName)) Next
Catch ex As Exception ' Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try Next ' Persist changes back to the DB using the configured adapter sqaReader.Update_XFC_CMD_UFR(dt,sqa, "Create") End Using End Using BRapi.Utilities.SetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "FormulateUFR", "UFR_ID", "")
Return Nothing End Function #End Region #End Region
#Region "UFR_Base_Info" #Region "Function: Get_UFR_Base_Info - Get UFR Base Info" Private Function Get_UFR_Base_Info() As TableView Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim xftv As New TableView() Dim ReqID As String = BRApi.Utilities.GetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si,si.UserName,"REQRetrieve","ReqIDs","") xftv.CanModifyData = True xftv.NumberOfEmptyRowsToAdd = 0 xftv.EmptyRowsBackgroundColor = XFColors.AliceBlue Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim sql As String = $"SELECT Req.[Army_Campaign_Objectives], Req.[Title], Req.[Initial_Review_Type], Req.[CMD_UFR_Tracking_No], Req.[Command_UFR_Priority], Req.[Command_UFR_Status], Req.[Create_Date], Req.[Create_User], Req.[Date_Decision_Needed_By], Req.[Description], Req.[Fund_Type], Req.[Funds_Required_By], Req.[MustFund], Req.[PEG], Req.[Study_Category], Req.[RDA_UFR_Executable_Fund_Year], Req.[RDA_UFR_FY_New_Start], Req.[Requirement_Background], Req.[Review_Entity], Req.[Review_Staff], Req.[REQ_Link_ID], Req.[ROC], Req.[Rollover_To_Next_UFR_Cycle], Req.[SAG_SSN], Req.[Solicited_NonSolicited], Req.[UFR_Capability_GAP], Req.[UFR_Capability_GAP_If_CMD_Fund], Req.[UFR_Driver], Req.[UFR_Driver_Explanation], Req.[UFR_ID], Req.[UFR_ID_Type], Req.[Update_Date], Req.[Update_User], Req.[WFCMD_Name], Req.[WFScenario_Name], Req.[WFTime_Name], Req.[FF_1], Req.[FF_2], Req.[FF_3], Req.[FF_4], Req.[FF_5], Req.[Secondary_Review_Staff], Req.[Notification_Email_List], Req.[Demotion_Comment], Req.[Gen_Comments_Notes], (SELECT STRING_AGG(CAST(Att.Attach_File_Name AS VARCHAR(MAX)), ', ') FROM XFC_CMD_UFR_Attachment AS Att WHERE Att.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = Req.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No) AS Attach_File_Name FROM XFC_CMD_UFR AS Req
WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}' --AND WFCMD_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}' AND WFTime_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}' AND Req.UFR_ID = '{ReqID}' "
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp,sql,False) End Using
xftv.PopulateFromDataTable(dt,True,True) Return xftv End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: Save_UFR_Base_Info - Save Create New UFR" Public Function Save_UFR_Base_Info() As Object ' Dim xftv As TableView = args.TableView 'Updated with safegaurd Dim xftv As New TableView() xftv = args.TableView If xftv Is Nothing OrElse xftv.Rows.Count = 0 Then Return Nothing Else Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sWFYear As String = TimeDimHelper.GetYearFromId(si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey)
Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si)
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open() Dim sqaReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_UFR(sqlConn)
Dim Sql As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_UFR WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name --AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name" Dim sqlparams As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() { New SqlParameter("@WFScenario_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFTime_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")} }
sqaReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_UFR_DT(sqa, dt, Sql, sqlparams)
For Each xftvRow As TableViewRow In xftv.Rows.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsHeader) Try Dim ufr_ID_Col = xftvRow.Item("CMD_UFR_Tracking_No") Dim targetRow As DataRow targetRow = dt.Select($"CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = '{ufr_ID_Col.OriginalValue.xfconverttoGUID}'").FirstOrDefault() Dim isInsert As Boolean = False
Dim sEntity As String = targetRow("Entity") Dim dtGetFundsCenterStaffing As DataTable = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetFundsCenterStaffing(si, globals, api, sEntity) Dim secondaryStaff As String = String.Empty Dim reviewStaff As String = xftvRow.Item("Review_Staff").Value For Each staffRow As DataRow In dtGetFundsCenterStaffing.Rows If staffRow("Primary_Staff").ToString().Equals(reviewStaff, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
If Not IsDBNull(staffRow("Secondary_Staff")) AndAlso staffRow("Secondary_Staff").ToString().Trim() <> "" Then secondaryStaff = staffRow("Secondary_Staff").ToString() Exit For End If End If Next
targetRow("Secondary_Review_Staff") = secondaryStaff
' Iterate each column/cell in the XFTV row and apply dirty changes to the DataRow ' Make a copy of the keys to avoid collection modification issues Dim dirtyColList As List(Of String) = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_XFTV_Helpers.Dirty_Column_List(si,xftvRow) For Each colName As String In dirtyColList targetRow(colName) = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_XFTV_Helpers.Convert_xftvCol_to_DbValue(si, xftvRow.Item(colName)) Next Catch ex As Exception ' Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try Next
' Persist changes back to the DB using the configured adapter sqaReader.Update_XFC_CMD_UFR(dt,sqa)
End Using End Using
End If
Return Nothing End Function #End Region
#End Region
#Region "Get UFR Base Info Staffing Params" Private Function Get_UFR_Base_Info_Staffing_Params(ByVal ColumnName As String) As TableView Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim xftv As New TableView() xftv.NumberOfEmptyRowsToAdd = 1 Dim sEntity As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved.XFGetValue("BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter","") If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sEntity) OrElse sEntity.Split(","c).Length > 1 Then Return Nothing Dim sLevel As String = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetEntityLevel(si, sEntity) Dim dtGetFundsCenterStaffing As DataTable If Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("HQ") AndAlso Not wfProfileFullName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("ABO") Then dtGetFundsCenterStaffing = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetFundsCenterStaffing(si, globals, api, sEntity) xftv.PopulateFromDataTable(dtGetFundsCenterStaffing,True,True) End If Return xftv
End Function
#End Region
#Region "Get BaseInfo Params" Private Function Get_REQ_Base_Info_Params(ByVal ColumnName As String) As TableView Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim xftv As New TableView() xftv.CanModifyData = False 'xftv.NumberOfEmptyRowsToAdd = 1 xftv.EmptyRowsBackgroundColor = XFColors.AliceBlue Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si)
Dim sql = $"SELECT Command,Cycle,Column_Name,Value FROM XFC_CMD_Cycle_Param_Values WHERE (Command = '{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}' OR Command = 'Army') AND Cycle = 'UFR' AND Column_Name = '{ColumnName}'"

#Region "Function: Save_Create_New_UFR - Save Create New UFR" Public Function Save_Copy_New_UFR() As Object Dim wfProfileFullName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim xftv As TableView = args.TableView Dim sEntity As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter") Dim UFR_ID As String = args.CustSubstVarsAlreadyResolved("IV_CMD_UFR_REQ_IDs") Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim sWFYear As String = TimeDimHelper.GetYearFromId(si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim U3DimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "U3_SAG")
Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si)
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open() Dim sqaReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_UFR(sqlConn) Dim Sql As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_UFR WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name" Dim sqlparams As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() { New SqlParameter("@WFScenario_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFCMD_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFTime_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")} } sqaReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_UFR_DT(sqa, dt, Sql, sqlparams) For Each xftvRow As TableViewRow In xftv.Rows.Where(Function(r) Not r.IsHeader) Try Dim targetRow As DataRow targetRow = dt.Select($"UFR_ID = '{UFR_ID}'").FirstOrDefault() Dim isInsert As Boolean = False
Dim dtGetFundsCenterStaffing As DataTable = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetFundsCenterStaffing(si, globals, api, sEntity) Dim secondaryStaff As String = String.Empty Dim reviewStaff As String = xftvRow.Item("Review_Staff").Value For Each staffRow As DataRow In dtGetFundsCenterStaffing.Rows If staffRow("Primary_Staff").ToString().Equals(reviewStaff, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then
If Not IsDBNull(staffRow("Secondary_Staff")) AndAlso staffRow("Secondary_Staff").ToString().Trim() <> "" Then secondaryStaff = staffRow("Secondary_Staff").ToString() Exit For End If End If Next
targetRow("Secondary_Review_Staff") = secondaryStaff
' Iterate each column/cell in the XFTV row and apply dirty changes to the DataRow ' Make a copy of the keys to avoid collection modification issues Dim dirtyColList As List(Of String) = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_XFTV_Helpers.Dirty_Column_List(si,xftvRow) For Each colName As String In dirtyColList targetRow(colName) = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_XFTV_Helpers.Convert_xftvCol_to_DbValue(si, xftvRow.Item(colName)) Next
Catch ex As Exception ' Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try Next ' Persist changes back to the DB using the configured adapter sqaReader.Update_XFC_CMD_UFR(dt,sqa, "Create") End Using End Using ' BRapi.Utilities.SetWorkspaceSessionSetting(si, si.UserName, "FormulateUFR", "UFR_ID", "")
Return Nothing End Function #End Region #End Region
End Class End Namespace

adapter.name: da_CMD_UFR_PivotGrid
adapter.sqlQuery:
SELECT s.REQ_ID, s.Title As [SPLN Req ID Title], s.Description AS [SPLN Req ID Description], s.Entity, sd.UD2, sd.UD3, sd.UD4, sd.UD5, sd.UD6, CASE WHEN sd.Account = 'UFR_Obligations' THEN COALESCE(sd.Month1,0) + COALESCE(sd.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month12, 0) END AS [UFR Obligation Amount], CASE WHEN sd.Account = 'UFR_Commitments' THEN COALESCE(sd.Month1,0) + COALESCE(sd.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month12, 0) END AS [UFR Commitment Amount], ud.FY AS [Requested Amount], u.UFR_ID, u.Title As [UFR Title], u.MustFund
FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ s INNER JOIN XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details sd ON s.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = sd.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR_Details ud ON sd.UD2 = ud.UD2 AND sd.UD3 = ud.UD3 AND sd.UD4 = ud.UD4 AND sd.UD5 = ud.UD5 AND sd.UD6 = ud.UD6 AND sd.Entity = ud.Entity
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR u ON ud.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = u.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No
WHERE s.Entity IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('|!BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter!|', ','))
AND COALESCE(sd.Month1, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month2, 0) > 0 --AND ud.FY > 0

adapter.name: da_CMD_UFR_SPLNUFRAmt
adapter.sqlQuery:
SELECT s.REQ_ID, s.Title As [SPLN Req ID Title], s.Description AS [SPLN Req ID Description], s.Entity, sd.UD2, sd.UD3, sd.UD4, sd.UD5, sd.UD6, CASE WHEN sd.Account = 'UFR_Obligations' THEN COALESCE(sd.Month1,0) + COALESCE(sd.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month12, 0) END AS [UFR Obligation Amount], CASE WHEN sd.Account = 'UFR_Commitments' THEN COALESCE(sd.Month1,0) + COALESCE(sd.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month12, 0) END AS [UFR Commitment Amount], ud.FY AS [Requested Amount], u.UFR_ID, u.Title As [UFR Title], u.MustFund
FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ s INNER JOIN XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details sd ON s.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = sd.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR_Details ud ON sd.UD2 = ud.UD2 AND sd.UD3 = ud.UD3 AND sd.UD4 = ud.UD4 AND sd.UD5 = ud.UD5 AND sd.UD6 = ud.UD6 AND sd.Entity = ud.Entity
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR u ON ud.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = u.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No
WHERE s.Entity IN (SELECT value FROM STRING_SPLIT('|!BL_CMD_UFR_FundsCenter!|', ','))
AND COALESCE(sd.Month1, 0) + COALESCE(sd.Month2, 0) > 0 --AND ud.FY > 0

file.sourceCode:
Imports System Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.IO Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Globalization Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports System.Windows.Forms Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName.BusinessRule.DashboardDataSet.CMD_FM_DataSet Public Class MainClass
Private si As SessionInfo Private globals As BRGlobals Private api As Object Private args As DashboardDataSetArgs
Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As Object, ByVal args As DashboardDataSetArgs) As Object Try Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.api = api Me.args = args
Select Case args.FunctionType
Case Is = DashboardDataSetFunctionType.GetDataSet Select Case args.DataSetName.ToLower() Case "dynretrievedatatable" Return Me.DynRetrieveDataTable() End Select
End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw New XFException(si, ex) End Try End Function
#Region "ImportReviewExecution" Public Function DynRetrieveDataTable() As Object Try Dim dt As New Datatable() Dim sDashboard As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("Dashboard") Dim wfProfileName As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).Name Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim sScenario = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim wfTimeNameRaw As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
Dim WfYear As Integer = TimeDimHelper.GetYearFromId(si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim iwfTimeNameRaw As Integer = wfTimeNameRaw.Split("M")(1) Dim wfTimeZeroInsert As String = String.Empty If iwfTimeNameRaw < 10 Then wfTimeZeroInsert = "00" Else wfTimeZeroInsert = "0" End If
Dim wfTimeName As String = WfYear & wfTimeZeroInsert & iwfTimeNameRaw
Dim SQL As New Text.StringBuilder
Select Case sDashboard Case "ImportReviewExecution"
#Region "SQL Query - ImportExecutionReview" SQL.AppendLine($"SELECT Et As [Entity], Sn As [Scenario], Ac As [Account], Tm As [Time], Am As [Amount], Vw As [View], Fw As [Flow], Ic As [IC], U1 As [U1_FundCode], U2 As [U2_MDEP], U3 As [U3_All_APE], U4 As [U4_DollarType], U5 As [U5_CType], U6 As [U6_CommitItem], U7 As [U7_UIC], U8 As [RootDimUD8], Lb As [Label], A1 As [Attribute_1], A2 As [Attribute_2], A3 As [Attribute_3], A4 As [Attribute_4], A5 As [Cost_Collector], A6 As [WBS], A7 As [WBS_Description], A8 As [Cost_Center], A9 As [FCA_Code], A10 As [FCA_Code_Description], A11 As [Funded_Program], A12 As [Source_System], A13 As [SSN], A14 As [SSN_Description], A15 As [Vendor], A16 As [Commitment_Doc_Ref_Tracking_No], A17 As [Contract_Number], A18 As [AOR] FROM dbo.vStageSourceAndAttributeData WHERE (Et Not Like 'A96%' And Et Not Like 'AHO%' And Et Not Like 'A78%' And Et Not Like 'AHP%' And Et Not Like 'AUS%') AND Sn = 'Execution' AND Tm = '{wfTimeName}' AND (U1 LIKE '2010%' OR U1 LIKE '2020%' OR U1 LIKE '2035%' OR U1 LIKE '2040%' OR U1 LIKE '2065%' OR U1 LIKE '2080%')")
#End Region
End Select
Using dbConn As DbConnInfo = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConn,SQL.ToString(),True) End Using Return dt
Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function #End Region
End Class End Namespace

Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly Imports Workspace.CMD_SPLN.CMD_SPLN_Assembly
