Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As Object, ByVal args As DashboardExtenderArgs) As Object
Try Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.api = api Me.args = args
Select Case args.FunctionType Case Is = DashboardExtenderFunctionType.ComponentSelectionChanged If args.FunctionName.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("CopySPLN") Then 'Implement Dashboard Component Selection Changed logic here. Me.CopySPLN()
Dim selectionChangedTaskResult As New XFSelectionChangedTaskResult() selectionChangedTaskResult.IsOK = True selectionChangedTaskResult.ShowMessageBox = False selectionChangedTaskResult.Message = "" selectionChangedTaskResult.ChangeSelectionChangedUIActionInDashboard = False selectionChangedTaskResult.ModifiedSelectionChangedUIActionInfo = Nothing selectionChangedTaskResult.ChangeSelectionChangedNavigationInDashboard = False selectionChangedTaskResult.ModifiedSelectionChangedNavigationInfo = Nothing selectionChangedTaskResult.ChangeCustomSubstVarsInDashboard = False selectionChangedTaskResult.ModifiedCustomSubstVars = Nothing selectionChangedTaskResult.ChangeCustomSubstVarsInLaunchedDashboard = False selectionChangedTaskResult.ModifiedCustomSubstVarsForLaunchedDashboard = Nothing Return selectionChangedTaskResult End If End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
#Region "Function: CopySPLN - Copy Spend Plan" Public Function CopySPLN()As Object Dim sCopySelected As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("CopySelected") Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim scName As String = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim cmd As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim tm As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") Dim fclist As New List (Of String) Dim APPNList As New List (Of String) Dim StatusList As New List (Of String)
Dim SPLN_SscName As String = "CMD_SPLN_C" & tm Dim SPLNRQSdt As New DataTable ("REQsFromSPLN") Dim SPLNfinalStatus As String = "L2_Final_SPLN" Dim SPLNAccount As String = "REQ_Funding"
Dim SPLNSrcREQsDT As New DataTable ("SPLNSrcREQsDT") Dim SPLNSrcREQDetailsDT As New DataTable ("SPLNSrcREQDetailsDT")
Dim SPLNTgtREQsDT As New DataTable ("SPLNTgtREQsDT") Dim SPLNTgtREQDetailsDT As New DataTable ("SPLNTgtREQDetailsDT")
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open()
'Prepare Source Requirement Header Table Dim sqaSPLNSrcReqReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details(sqlConn) Dim sqlSPLNSrcReq As String = $"Select * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ AS Req WHERE Req.WFScenario_Name = '{SPLN_SscName}' AND Req.WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' AND Req.WFTime_Name = '{tm}' " #Region "Use after testing" ' Dim sqlSPLNSrcReq As String = $"Select * ' FROM XFC_CMD_PGM_REQ AS Req ' WHERE Req.WFScenario_Name = '{SPLN_SscName}' ' AND Req.WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' ' AND Req.WFTime_Name = '{tm}' ' AND Req.Status = '{SPLNfinalStatus}'" #End Region
Dim sqlparamsSPLNSrcReq As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaSPLNSrcReqReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_DT(sqa, SPLNSrcREQsDT, sqlSPLNSrcReq, sqlparamsSPLNSrcReq)
'Prepare Source Requirement Detail Table Dim sqaSPLNSrcREQDetailReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details(sqlConn) Dim SqlSPLNSrcReqDetail As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{SPLN_SscName}' And WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}' " #Region "Use after testing" ' Dim SqlSPLNSrcReqDetail As String = $"SELECT * ' FROM XFC_CMD_PGM_REQ_Details ' WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{SPLN_SscName}' ' And WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' ' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}' ' AND Flow = '{SPLNfinalStatus}' ' AND Account = 'Req_Funding'" #End Region Dim sqlparamsSPLNSrcReqDetails As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaSPLNSrcREQDetailReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_DT(sqa, SPLNSrcREQDetailsDT, SqlSPLNSrcReqDetail, sqlparamsSPLNSrcReqDetails)
'Get existing Target Requirement Header Table Dim sqaSPLNReqReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ(sqlConn) Dim SqlSPLNReq As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{scName}' And WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}'"
Dim sqlparamsSPLNReq As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaSPLNReqReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DT(sqa, SPLNTgtREQsDT, SqlSPLNReq, sqlparamsSPLNReq)
'Get existing Target Requirement Detail Table Dim sqaSPLNReqDetailReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details(sqlConn) Dim SqlSPLNReqDetail As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{scName}' And WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}' "
Dim sqlparamsSPLNReqDetails As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaSPLNReqDetailReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_DT(sqa, SPLNTgtREQDetailsDT, SqlSPLNReqDetail, sqlparamsSPLNReqDetails)
'Creating new records for header and details table Dim newREQRows As New List(Of DataRow) Dim newREQDetailRows As New List(Of DataRow)
Dim stagingReqTable As DataTable = SPLNTgtREQsDT.Clone() Dim stagingDetailTable As DataTable = SPLNTgtREQDetailsDT.Clone()
For Each row As DataRow In SPLNSrcREQsDT.Rows Dim newGuidObj As Object = System.Guid.NewGuid() Dim newGuid As String = Convert.ToString(newGuidObj)
Dim newREQRow As datarow = stagingReqTable.NewRow()
'Map the Source Header to Target Header Me.MapSrcSPLNReqToTgtSPLN(newREQRow, row,FCList,APPNList,StatusList,newGuid)
'Add row to the header table stagingReqTable.Rows.Add(newREQRow)
Dim foundDetailRows As DataRow() = SPLNSrcREQDetailsDT.Select(String.Format("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = '{0}'", row("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID").ToString()))
For Each dtRow In foundDetailRows
Dim newDetailRow As DataRow = stagingDetailTable.NewRow()
'Map the Source Detail to Target Detail Me.MapSPLNSrcReqDetailToSPLNTgtDetail(newDetailRow, dtRow, newGuid)
'Audit UpdateAuditColumns(newDetailRow)
'Add row to the details table stagingDetailTable.Rows.Add(newDetailRow)
Next Next
sqaSPLNReqReader.MergeandSync_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_toDB(si, stagingReqTable, SPLNTgtREQsDT) sqaSPLNReqDetailReader.MergeandSync_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_toDB(si, stagingDetailTable, SPLNTgtREQDetailsDT)
Dim EntityLists = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetEntityLists(si,FCList,"CMD_SPLN") Dim joinedentitylist = EntityLists.Item1.union(EntityLists.Item2).ToList()
For Each JoinedEntity As String In joinedentitylist globals.SetStringValue($"FundsCenterStatusUpdates - {JoinedEntity}", String.Join("|",StatusList)) Globals.setStringValue($"FundsCenterStatusappnUpdates - {JoinedEntity}",String.Join("|",APPNList)) Next
Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Line 205") Dim wsID = BRApi.Dashboards.Workspaces.GetWorkspaceIDFromName(si, False,"80 CMD FM") Dim currentYear As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") Dim nextyear As String = currentYear + 1 Dim customSubstVars As New Dictionary(Of String, String) customSubstVars.Add("WFScen",wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")) customSubstVars.Add("WFTime",$"T#{currentYear}M1,T#{currentYear}M2,T#{currentYear}M3,T#{currentYear}M4,T#{currentYear}M5,T#{currentYear}M6,T#{currentYear}M7,T#{currentYear}M8,T#{currentYear}M9,T#{currentYear}M10,T#{currentYear}M11,T#{currentYear}M12,T#{nextyear}") BRApi.Utilities.ExecuteDataMgmtSequence(si, wsID, "CMD_FM_Copy_SPLN", customSubstVars) Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Line 210")

End Function #End Region

SPLNTgtDetailRow("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID") = newGuid.XFConvertToGuid() SPLNTgtDetailRow("WFScenario_Name") = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") SPLNTgtDetailRow("WFCMD_Name") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("WFCMD_Name") SPLNTgtDetailRow("WFTime_Name") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("WFTime_Name") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Unit_of_Measure") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Unit_of_Measure") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Entity") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Entity") SPLNTgtDetailRow("IC") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("IC") ' SPLNTgtDetailRow("Account") = acct SPLNTgtDetailRow("Account") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Account") ' SPLNTgtDetailRow("Flow") = GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetEntityLevel(si, SPLNSrcDetailRow("Entity")) & "_Formulate_SPLN" 'would be updated in the update peorcess in the helper SPLNTgtDetailRow("Flow") = "Top" SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD1") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD1") SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD2") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD2") SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD3") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD3") SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD4") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD4") SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD5") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD5")
If SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD6").ToString.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("None") Then SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD6") = "None" Else SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD6") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD6") & "_General" End If
SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD7") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD7") SPLNTgtDetailRow("UD8") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD8") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Fiscal_Year") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Fiscal_Year") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month1") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month1") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month2") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month2") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month3") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month3") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month4") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month4") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month5") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month5") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month6") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month6") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month7") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month7") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month8") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month8") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month9") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month9") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month10") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month10") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month11") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month11") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Month12") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Month12") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Quarter1") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Quarter1") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Quarter2") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Quarter2") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Quarter3") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Quarter3") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Quarter4") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Quarter4") Dim APPN As String = SPLNSrcDetailRow("UD1") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Fiscal_Year") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Fiscal_Year") SPLNTgtDetailRow("Yearly") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("Yearly") SPLNTgtDetailRow("AllowUpdate") = SPLNSrcDetailRow("AllowUpdate") 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "currYearAmt: " & currYearAmt & ", Month 2: Spread: " & spread(2) & ", amt: " & SPLNDetailRow("Month2").ToString & ", Month 6: Spread: " & spread(6) & ", amt: " & SPLNDetailRow("Month6").ToString ) UpdateAuditColumns(SPLNTgtDetailRow) End Sub
#End Region
#Region "Function: GetExistingDupREQs - Get Existing Row"
Function GetExistingDupREQs(ByRef REQsToRollover As List(Of String)) As List(Of String)
Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim scName As String = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim cmd As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim tm As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
Dim SPLNTgtREQsDT As New DataTable() Dim existingREQs As New List(Of String)
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open() Dim sqaREQReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ(sqlConn) Dim SqlREQ As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{scName}' And WFCMD_Name = '{cmd}' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}'"
Dim sqlparamsREQ As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaREQReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DT(sqa, SPLNTgtREQsDT, SqlREQ, sqlparamsREQ)
End Using End Using
For Each row In SPLNTgtREQsDT.Rows Dim REQinDB As String = row("REQ_ID").ToString If REQsToRollover.Contains(REQinDB) Then existingREQs.Add(REQinDB) End If Next Return existingREQs End Function
#End Region
#Region "POTENTIALLY DELETE *** Get Monthly Spread"
Public Function GetMonthlySpread(ByRef UD1 As String, ByRef acct As String ,ByRef spread As Dictionary(Of Integer, Decimal)) As Decimal
Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim cubeName As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim entity As String = GetCmdFundCenterFromCube() Dim scenario As String = "RMW_Cycle_Config_Monthly" Dim tm As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
For i As Integer = 1 To 12 Dim spreadPct As Decimal = 0
Dim spreadmbrScript = $"Cb#{cubeName}:E#{entity}:C#Local:S#{scenario}:T#{tm}M{i}:V#Periodic:A#{acct}:F#None:O#AdjInput:I#None:U1#{UD1}:U2#None:U3#None:U4#None:U5#None:U6#None:U7#None:U8#None" spreadPct = BRApi.Finance.Data.GetDataCellUsingMemberScript(si, cubeName, spreadmbrScript).DataCellEx.DataCell.CellAmount spreadPct = spreadPct/100 spread.Add(i,spreadPct) 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "spreadmbrScript: " & spreadmbrScript & ", Amount = " & spreadPct)
Next
Return Nothing
End Function
#End Region
#Region "POTENTIALLY DELETE *** get GUID"
Public Function getGUID(ByRef REQ As DataTable) As String
Dim GUIDs As String = "'" For Each r As DataRow In REQ.Rows GUIDs = GUIDs & r("CMD_PGM_REQ_ID").ToString & "'," Next GUIDs = GUIDs.Substring(0,GUIDs.Length-1)
Return GUIDs
End Function
#End Region
#Region "POTENTIALLY DELETE *** Cmd FundCenter From Cube"
Public Function GetCmdFundCenterFromCube() As String
Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim profileName = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim cubeName As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim entityMem As Member = BRApi.Finance.Metadata.GetMember(si, DimType.Entity.Id, cubeName).Member Dim wfScenarioTypeID As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Scenario.GetScenarioType(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ScenarioKey).Id Dim wfTime As String = BRApi.Finance.Time.GetNameFromId(si,si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim wfTimeId As Integer = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMemberId(si,DimType.Time.Id,wfTime)
Dim fundCenter As String = BRApi.Finance.Entity.Text(si, entityMem.MemberId, 1, wfScenarioTypeID, wfTimeId)
Return fundCenter End Function
#End Region
#Region "POTENTIALLY DELETE *** Get Fund Code" Public Function GetFundCode(ByRef UD1 As String, ByRef UD4 As String) As String Dim fundCode As String = String.Empty Dim APPNMap As New Dictionary(Of (String, String), String) 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "UD1= " & UD1 & ", UD4= " & UD4) If globals.GetObject($"AppropriationMapping") Is Nothing Then 'If APPNMap.Count = 0 Then GetAPPNMapping() APPNMap = globals.GetObject($"AppropriationMapping") Else APPNMap = globals.GetObject($"AppropriationMapping") End If 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"AppropriationMapping count = " & APPNMap.Count) Dim key As (String, String) = (UD1, UD4)
If APPNMap.TryGetValue(key, fundCode) Then 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"fundCode = " & fundCode) 'Validate member Dim validFCList As New List(Of String) If globals.GetObject($"UD1_FundCenter_MemberList") Is Nothing Then GetValidFundCodes() validFCList = globals.GetObject($"UD1_FundCenter_MemberList") Else validFCList = globals.GetObject($"UD1_FundCenter_MemberList") End If 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"validFCList count = " & validFCList.Count) If Not validFCList.Contains(fundCode) Then Dim errMessage As String = $"Invalid Fundcode {fundCode} identified for the combilation Appropriation {UD1} and Dollar Type {UD4}." 'Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, New Exception(errMessage))) fundCode = fundCode.Replace("27","26") End If
Else Dim errMessage As String = $"No valid Fundcode for the combilation Appropriation {UD1} and Dollar Type {UD4}." 'Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, New Exception(errMessage))) fundCode = "201011D" End If
Return fundCode
End Function
Public Function GetValidFundCodes() Dim fundCodeList As New List(Of String) Dim dimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "U1_FundCode") Dim mbrList As List(Of memberinfo) = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, dimPk, $"U1#Top.Base" , True) For Each m In mbrList fundCodeList.Add(m.Member.Name) Next 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"fundCodeList = " & fundCodeList.Count) globals.SetObject("UD1_FundCenter_MemberList", fundCodeList)
Return Nothing End Function
Public Function GetAPPNMapping()
Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim tm As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") Dim year As String = tm.Substring(2,2)
Dim APPNMap As New Dictionary(Of (String, String), String)
Dim SQL As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_APPN_Mapping" Dim dt As New DataTable Using dbConn As DbConnInfo = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dt = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConn,SQL,True) End Using
For Each row In dt.Rows APPNMap.Add((row("Appropriation_CD"), row("Dollar_Type")),row("Partial_Fund_CD") & year) 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, row("Appropriation_CD").toString & " : " & row("Dollar_Type").ToString & " : " & row("Partial_Fund_CD").ToString & year) Next
globals.SetObject("AppropriationMapping", APPNMap)
Return Nothing End Function
#End Region
#Region "Get Rate" Private Function GetFDXCMDSPLNData(ByVal cvName As String,ByVal entFilter As String) As DataTable Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim wsName As String = "50 CMD SPLN" Dim wsID As Guid = BRApi.Dashboards.Workspaces.GetWorkspaceIDFromName(si,False,wsName) Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si)
Dim entDim = $"E_{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}" Dim scenDim = "S_RMW" Dim scenFilter = $"S#{wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}" Dim timeFilter = String.Empty '$"T#{wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}" Dim NameValuePairs = New Dictionary(Of String,String)
Dim nvbParams As NameValueFormatBuilder = New NameValueFormatBuilder(String.Empty,NameValuePairs,False)
dt = BRApi.Import.Data.FdxExecuteCubeViewTimePivot(si, wsID, cvName, entDim, $"E#{entFilter}", scenDim, scenFilter, timeFilter, nvbParams, False, True, True, String.Empty, 8, False)
Return dt End Function #End Region
#End Region
End Class End Namespace

Imports System Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.IO Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Globalization Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Imports System.Windows.Forms Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports System.Text.RegularExpressions Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800 Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly Imports Workspace.CMD_SPLN.CMD_SPLN_Assembly Imports System.IO.Compression
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName.BusinessRule.DashboardExtender.CMD_FM_Helper Public Class MainClass Private si As SessionInfo Public globals As BRGlobals Private api As Object Private args As DashboardExtenderArgs
Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As Object, ByVal args As DashboardExtenderArgs) As Object Try Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.api = api Me.args = args
Select Case args.FunctionType Case Is = DashboardExtenderFunctionType.LoadDashboard Dim dbExt_LoadResult As New XFLoadDashboardTaskResult() Select Case args.FunctionName.ToLower() ' Case "load_req_detailsdashboard" ' dbExt_LoadResult = Me.load_req_detailsdashboard() ' Return dbExt_LoadResult End Select
Case Is = DashboardExtenderFunctionType.ComponentSelectionChanged '====Validate whether a wf is locked or not==== Dim dbExt_ChangedResult As New XFSelectionChangedTaskResult() Dim dargs As New DashboardExtenderArgs dargs.FunctionName = "Check_WF_Complete_Lock" ' Dim sWFStatus As String = GBL_Helper.Main(si, globals, api, dargs) ' If Not sWFStatus.XFContainsIgnoreCase("unlock") ' dbExt_ChangedResult.IsOK = False ' dbExt_ChangedResult.ShowMessageBox = True ' dbExt_ChangedResult.Message = vbCRLF & "Current workflow step is locked. Please contact your requriements manager to open access." & vbCRLF ' Return dbExt_ChangedResult ' End If Select Case args.FunctionName.ToLower() ' Case "check_wf_complete_lock" ' dbExt_ChangedResult = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.Check_WF_Complete_Lock(si, globals, api, args) ' Return dbExt_ChangedResult Case "saveadjustfundingline" dbExt_ChangedResult = Me.SaveAdjustFundingLine() Return dbExt_ChangedResult End Select End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw ErrorHandler.LogWrite(si, New XFException(si, ex)) End Try End Function
#Region "Save Adjust Funding Line " Public Function SaveAdjustFundingLine() As xfselectionchangedTaskResult Dim req_IDs As String = args.SelectionChangedTaskInfo.CustomSubstVarsWithUserSelectedValues.XFGetValue("IV_CMD_FM_REQ_IDs","NA") Dim WFInfoDetails As New Dictionary(Of String, String)() Dim wfInitInfo = BRApi.Workflow.General.GetUserWorkflowInitInfo(si) Dim wfUnitInfo = wfInitInfo.GetSelectedWorkflowUnitInfo() Dim wfCubeRootInfo = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si,wfUnitInfo.ProfileName) WFInfoDetails.Add("ProfileName", wfUnitInfo.ProfileName) WFInfoDetails.Add("ScenarioName", wfUnitInfo.ScenarioName) WFInfoDetails.Add("TimeName", wfUnitInfo.TimeName) WFInfoDetails.Add("CMDName", wfCubeRootInfo.CubeName) Dim WFYear As Integer = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") Dim nextyear As Integer = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") + 1 Dim fclist As New List (Of String) Dim APPNList As New List (Of String) Dim StatusList As New List (Of String) Dim isUFR As String =args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("Function")
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open()
' ************************************ ' *** Fetch Data for BOTH tables ***** ' ************************************ ' --- Main Request Table (XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ) --- Dim dt As New DataTable() Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim sqaReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ(sqlConn) Dim sqlMain As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name AND REQ_ID = @REQ_ID" Dim sqlParams As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() { New SqlParameter("@WFScenario_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFCMD_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFTime_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}, New SqlParameter("@REQ_ID", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = req_IDs} } sqaReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DT(sqa, dt, sqlMain, sqlParams)
' --- Details Table (XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details) --- Dim dt_Details As New DataTable() Dim sqa2 As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim sqaReaderdetail As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details(sqlConn) Dim parentIds As New List(Of String)()
For Each parentRow As DataRow In dt.Rows If Not IsDBNull(parentRow("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID")) Then ' Get the CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID value and parse it as Guid Dim columnValue As Object = parentRow("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID") Dim reqIdAsGuid As Guid = Guid.Parse(columnValue.ToString())
parentIds.Add(reqIdAsGuid.ToString()) End If Next
' Select a single CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID (assuming the requirement is only one ID for the query) Dim singleCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID As String = parentIds(0) Dim sql As String = "" ' Build the SQL query with the single CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID sql = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name AND CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = @SingleCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID"
' Create the list of SQL parameters Dim detailsParams As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter(){ New SqlParameter("@WFScenario_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFCMD_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}, New SqlParameter("@WFTime_Name", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}, New SqlParameter("@SingleCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID", SqlDbType.NVarChar) With {.Value = singleCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID} }
' Fill the details table with the query results sqaReaderdetail.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_DT(sqa2, dt_Details, sql, detailsParams) 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"dtdetailscount = " & dt_Details.Rows.count & ": " & sql & ": reqIDS " & singleCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID) Dim sqa_xfc_cmd_spln_req_details_audit = New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT(sqlConn) Dim SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT = New DataTable()
Dim SQL_Audit As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_Audit WHERE WFScenario_Name = @WFScenario_Name AND WFCMD_Name = @WFCMD_Name AND WFTime_Name = @WFTime_Name AND CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = @SingleCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID"
sqa_xfc_cmd_spln_req_details_audit.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_Audit_DT(sqa, SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT, SQL_Audit, detailsParams) ' ************************************ ' ************************************ Dim targetRow As DataRow
targetRow = dt.Select($"REQ_ID = '{req_IDs}'").FirstOrDefault()
Dim APPN As String = "" Dim Entity As String = ""
If isUFR.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("UFR") Then APPN = targetRow("APPN") Entity = targetRow("Entity") Else If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("APPN")) Then APPN = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("APPN") Else APPN = targetRow("APPN") End If Entity = targetRow("Entity") End If
Dim UD1objDimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si,"U1_FundCode") Dim lsAncestorListU1 As List(Of MemberInfo) lsAncestorListU1 = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, UD1objDimPk, "U1#" & APPN & ".Ancestors.Where(MemberDim = 'U1_APPN')", True) APPNList.add(lsAncestorListU1(0).Member.Name)
fclist.Add(entity) Dim MDEP As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("MDEP") Dim APE As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("APEPT") Dim DollarType As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("DollarType") Dim cTypecol As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("CType") Dim obj_class As String = args.NameValuePairs.XFGetValue("Obj_Class") Dim Status As String = targetRow("Status") statuslist.Add(status) Dim Create_User As String = targetRow("Create_User") Dim Req_Type As String Dim UD6objDimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si,"U6_CommitItem") Dim lsAncestorListU6 As List(Of MemberInfo) Dim req_ID_Val As Guid req_ID_Val = targetRow("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID")
If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(APPN) Then targetRow("APPN") = APPN End If If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(MDEP) Then targetRow("MDEP") = MDEP End If If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(APE) Then targetRow("APE9") = APE End If If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(DollarType) Then targetRow("Dollar_Type") = DollarType End If If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(obj_class) Then targetRow("Obj_Class") = obj_class End If If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cTypecol) Then targetRow("CType") = cTypecol End If
lsAncestorListU6 = BRApi.Finance.Members.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, UD6objDimPk, "U6#" & targetRow("Obj_Class").ToString & ".Ancestors.Where(MemberDim = 'U6_CostCat')", True) If lsAncestorListU6(0).Member.Name = "Pay_Benefits" Then Req_Type = "CivPay" Else Req_Type = "Requirement" End If targetRow("REQ_ID_Type") = Req_Type
targetRow("Update_Date") = DateTime.Now targetRow("Update_User") = si.UserName
Dim targetRowFunding As DataRow Dim targetRowFundingCarryover As DataRow 'targetRowFunding = dt_Details.Select($"CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = '{req_ID_Val}'").FirstOrDefault()
Dim accountList As New List(Of String) If isUFR.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("UFR") Then accountList.AddRange({"UFR_Obligations", "UFR_Commitments"}) Else accountList.AddRange({"Obligations", "Commitments","Carryover_Commitments","Carryover_Obligations"}) If dt_Details.AsEnumerable().Any(Function(u) u.Field(Of String)("Account") = "UFR_Obligations") Then accountList.Add("UFR_Obligations") If dt_Details.AsEnumerable().Any(Function(u) u.Field(Of String)("Account") = "UFR_Commitments") Then accountList.Add("UFR_Commitments") End If 'Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "cTypecol 1" & cTypecol) For Each accountName As String In accountList WFYear = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") If accountName = "Carryover_Commitments" Then accountname = "Commitments" wfyear = nextyear Else If accountName = "Carryover_Obligations" Then accountname = "Obligations" wfyear = nextyear End If 'brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"Account = " & accountName) targetRowFunding = dt_Details.Select($"CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = '{req_ID_Val}' AND Account = '{accountName}' and Fiscal_year = '{wfyear}'").FirstOrDefault() 'If SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT.Rows.Count > 0 Then If SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT.Select($"CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = '{req_ID_Val}' AND Account = '{accountName}' and Fiscal_year = '{wfyear}'").Count > 0 Then
Dim drow As DataRow
drow = SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT.Select($"CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = '{req_ID_Val}' AND Account = '{accountName}' and Fiscal_year = '{wfyear}'").FirstOrDefault() drow("Orig_UD1") = targetRow("APPN") drow("Updated_UD1") = APPN drow("Orig_UD2") = targetRow("MDEP") drow("Updated_UD2") = MDEP drow("Orig_UD3") = targetRow("APE9") drow("Updated_UD3") = APE drow("Orig_UD4") = targetRow("Dollar_Type") drow("Updated_UD4") = DollarType drow("Orig_UD5") = targetRow("CType") drow("Updated_UD5") = cTypecol drow("Orig_UD6") = targetRow("Obj_Class") drow("Updated_UD6") = obj_class drow("Orig_UD7") = "None" drow("Updated_UD7") = "None" drow("Orig_UD8") = "None" drow("Updated_UD8") = "None"
Else
Dim newrow As datarow = SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT.NewRow() newrow("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID") = targetRow("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID") newrow("WFScenario_Name") = targetRow("WFScenario_Name") newrow("WFCMD_Name") = targetRow("WFCMD_Name") newrow("WFTime_Name") = targetRow("WFTime_Name") newrow("Entity") = targetRow("Entity") newrow("Account") = accountName newrow("Fiscal_Year") = wfyear newrow("Orig_IC") = "None" newrow("Updated_IC") = "None" newrow("Orig_Flow") = targetRow("Status") newrow("Updated_Flow") = targetRow("Status") newrow("Orig_UD1") = targetRow("APPN") newrow("Updated_UD1") = APPN newrow("Orig_UD2") = targetRow("MDEP") newrow("Updated_UD2") = MDEP newrow("Orig_UD3") = targetRow("APE9") newrow("Updated_UD3") = APE newrow("Orig_UD4") = targetRow("Dollar_Type") newrow("Updated_UD4") = DollarType newrow("Orig_UD5") = targetRow("CType") newrow("Updated_UD5") = cTypecol newrow("Orig_UD6") = targetRow("Obj_Class") newrow("Updated_UD6") = obj_class newrow("Orig_UD7") = "None" newrow("Updated_UD7") = "None" newrow("Orig_UD8") = "None" newrow("Updated_UD8") = "None" newrow("Create_Date") = DateTime.Now newrow("Create_User") = si.UserName
SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DETAILS_AUDIT_DT.rows.add(newrow)
End If
Dim targetRowFYValues As DataRow targetRowFYValues = dt_Details.Select($"CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = '{req_ID_Val}' AND Account = '{accountName}' and Fiscal_year = '{wfyear}'").FirstOrDefault() Dim Yearly As Decimal Dim Month1 As Decimal Dim Month2 As Decimal Dim Month3 As Decimal Dim Month4 As Decimal Dim Month5 As Decimal Dim Month6 As Decimal Dim Month7 As Decimal Dim Month8 As Decimal Dim Month9 As Decimal Dim Month10 As Decimal Dim Month11 As Decimal Dim Month12 As Decimal Dim Quarter1 As Decimal Dim Quarter2 As Decimal Dim Quarter3 As Decimal Dim Quarter4 As Decimal

#Region "Function: GetExistingRow" Public Function GetExistingRow(ByRef dt As DataTable, ByRef account As String) As DataRow For Each row In dt.Rows If (row("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID").ToString().XFContainsIgnoreCase(row("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID").ToString) AndAlso row("Start_Year").ToString().XFContainsIgnoreCase(row("Start_Year").ToString) AndAlso row("UNIT_OF_MEASURE").ToString().XFContainsIgnoreCase(row("UNIT_OF_MEASURE").ToString) AndAlso row("Account").ToString().XFContainsIgnoreCase(account)) Return row End If Next Return Nothing End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: CleanUp Special Characters"
Function CleanUpSpecialCharacters(value As String) As String Dim allowedChars As String = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789,""@!#$%'()+=_.:><?~-[]*^/" & vbCrLf & vbLf Dim result As New StringBuilder()
'If there are back to back (escaped) double quotes, they will be replaced with single quotes. 'This is done becasue "s are used as column separator in csv files and "s inside would be represented as escaped quotes ("") value = value.Replace("""""", "'")
'this handles ZWSP's that get brought in as "???" and ignored by the second pass as question marks are allowed value = value.Replace("???", " ")
For Each c As Char In value If allowedChars.Contains(c) Then result.Append(c) Else result.Append(" ") End If Next
Return result.ToString() End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: Parse Csv Line Format"
Function ParseCsvLine(line As String) As String()
'Use reg expressions to split the csv. 'The expression accounts for commas that are with in "" to treat them as data. Dim pattern As String = ",(?=(?:[^""]*""[^""]*"")*[^""]*$)" Dim fields As String () = Regex.Split(line, pattern) Return fields
End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: setup Split And Insert Into REQ Tables"
Function SplitAndInsertIntoREQTables(ByRef fullDT As DataTable, ByRef targetREQDT As DataTable, ByRef tergetREQDTDetail As DataTable )

Dim sqaREQReader As New Workspace.CMD_SPLN.CMD_SPLN_Assembly.SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ(sqlConn) Dim sqaREQDetailReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details(sqlConn)
Dim srcREQDT As DataTable = targetREQDT.Clone() Dim srcREQDetailDT As DataTable = tergetREQDTDetail.Clone()
Me.SplitFullDataTable(fullDT, srcREQDT, srcREQDetailDT, targetREQDT) BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si , " Split 11") sqaREQReader.MergeandSync_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_toDB(si, srcREQDT, targetREQDT) BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si , " Split 12") sqaREQDetailReader.MergeandSync_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_toDB(si, srcREQDetailDT, tergetREQDTDetail)
BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si , " Split 13")

#Region"Function: Split dataset" Public Function SplitFullDataTable (ByRef fullDT As DataTable, ByRef REQDT As DataTable, ByRef REQDTDetail As DataTable, ByRef tergetREQDT As DataTable) As Object ' Split and translate data per row
For Each row As DataRow In fullDT.Rows
' Handle REQDT translation and insertion/update Dim REQExists As Boolean = False Dim existingREQ_ID As String = row("REQ_ID") Dim existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID As String Dim MappingForREQ As New Dictionary(Of String, String) MappingForREQ = GetMappingForREQ() Dim existingRowREQDT As DataRow = tergetREQDT.Select($"REQ_ID = '{existingREQ_ID}'").FirstOrDefault()
If existingRowREQDT IsNot Nothing Then REQExists = True existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = existingRowREQDT("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID").ToString existingREQ_ID = existingRowREQDT("REQ_ID").ToString Else 'existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = Guid.NewGuid().ToString() existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetNewSequentialGuid(si).ToString() End If
' Create a new row Dim newRowREQDT As DataRow = REQDT.NewRow() newRowREQDT("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID") = existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID
For Each fullCol As KeyValuePair (Of String, String) In MappingForREQ
If row.Table.Columns.Contains(fullCol.Key) Then If REQDT.Columns(fullCol.Value).DataType Is GetType(DateTime) Then Dim tempDate As DateTime If DateTime.TryParse(row(fullCol.Key), tempDate) Then newRowREQDT(MappingForREQ(fullCol.Key)) = row(fullCol.Key) Else newRowREQDT(MappingForREQ(fullCol.Key)) = DBNull.Value End If Else If Not fullCol.Key.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID") Then newRowREQDT(MappingForREQ(fullCol.Key)) = row(fullCol.Key) End If End If Else 'if column doesn't come from the table and is not accounted for leave it blamk newRowREQDT(MappingForREQ(fullCol.Key)) = DBNull.Value End If
Next 'If it is an existing row we will keep the original REC_ID. All the data will be from the file If REQExists Then Me.UpdateExistingREQIDs(newRowREQDT, existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID, existingREQ_ID) End If REQDT.Rows.Add(newRowREQDT) ' ' Create a new row Dim MappingForREQDetailsObligation As New Dictionary(Of String, String) MappingForREQDetailsObligation = GetMappingForREQDetails("obl") Dim newRowREQDTDetailObligation As DataRow = REQDTDetail.NewRow() For Each fullCol As String In MappingForREQDetailsObligation.Keys newRowREQDTDetailObligation(MappingForREQDetailsObligation(fullCol)) = row(fullCol) Next 'Map funding to the regular FYDEP
newRowREQDTDetailObligation("Account") = "Obligations" newRowREQDTDetailObligation("UNIT_OF_MEASURE") = "Funding" newRowREQDTDetailObligation("Quarter1") = convert.ToInt32(row("OBL OCT")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL NOV")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL DEC")) newRowREQDTDetailObligation("Quarter2") = convert.ToInt32(row("OBL JAN")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL FEB")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL MAR")) newRowREQDTDetailObligation("Quarter3") = convert.ToInt32(row("OBL APR")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL MAY")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL JUN")) newRowREQDTDetailObligation("Quarter4") = convert.ToInt32(row("OBL JUL")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL AUG")) + convert.ToInt32(row("OBL SEP")) 'If REQExists Then Me.UpdateExistingREQIDs(newRowREQDTDetailObligation, existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID, existingREQ_ID) 'End If REQDTDetail.Rows.Add(newRowREQDTDetailObligation)
' ' Handle REQDTDetail Items Dim MappingForREQDetailsCommitment As New Dictionary(Of String, String) MappingForREQDetailsCommitment = GetMappingForREQDetails("com") ' Create a new row Dim newRowREQDTDetailCommitment As DataRow = REQDTDetail.NewRow() For Each fullCol As String In MappingForREQDetailsCommitment.Keys newRowREQDTDetailCommitment(MappingForREQDetailsCommitment(fullCol)) = row(fullCol) Next
newRowREQDTDetailCommitment("Account") = "Commitments" newRowREQDTDetailCommitment("UNIT_OF_MEASURE") = "Funding" newRowREQDTDetailCommitment("Quarter1") = convert.ToInt32(row("COM OCT")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM NOV")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM DEC")) newRowREQDTDetailCommitment("Quarter2") = convert.ToInt32(row("COM JAN")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM FEB")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM MAR")) newRowREQDTDetailCommitment("Quarter3") = convert.ToInt32(row("COM APR")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM MAY")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM JUN")) newRowREQDTDetailCommitment("Quarter4") = convert.ToInt32(row("COM JUL")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM AUG")) + convert.ToInt32(row("COM SEP"))
'If REQExists Then Me.UpdateExistingREQIDs(newRowREQDTDetailCommitment, existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID, existingREQ_ID) 'End If REQDTDetail.Rows.Add(newRowREQDTDetailCommitment) If CheckComCarryover(row) Then Dim MappingForREQDetailsCommitmentCarryover As New Dictionary(Of String, String) MappingForREQDetailsCommitmentCarryover = GetMappingForREQDetails("com_carryover") ' Create a new row Dim newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover As DataRow = REQDTDetail.NewRow() For Each fullCol As String In MappingForREQDetailsCommitmentCarryover.Keys newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover(MappingForREQDetailsCommitmentCarryover(fullCol)) = row(fullCol) Next
newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover("Account") = "Commitments" newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover("UNIT_OF_MEASURE") = "Funding" newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover("Fiscal_Year") = row("Fiscal Year") + 1 newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover("Yearly") = row("COM Carryover")
'If REQExists Then Me.UpdateExistingREQIDs(newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover, existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID, existingREQ_ID) 'End If REQDTDetail.Rows.Add(newRowREQDTDetailCommitmentCarryover) End If
If CheckOblCarryover(row) Then Dim MappingForREQDetailsObligationCarryover As New Dictionary(Of String, String) MappingForREQDetailsObligationCarryover = GetMappingForREQDetails("obl_carryover") ' Create a new row Dim newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover As DataRow = REQDTDetail.NewRow() For Each fullCol As String In MappingForREQDetailsObligationCarryover.Keys newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover(MappingForREQDetailsObligationCarryover(fullCol)) = row(fullCol) Next
newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover("Account") = "Obligations" newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover("UNIT_OF_MEASURE") = "Funding" newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover("Fiscal_Year") = row("Fiscal Year") + 1 newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover("Yearly") = row("OBL Carryover") 'If REQExists Then Me.UpdateExistingREQIDs(newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover, existingCMD_SPLN_REQ_ID, existingREQ_ID) 'End If REQDTDetail.Rows.Add(newRowREQDTDetailObligationCarryover) End If
' Handle REQDTDetail Quantity Next
End Function

Public Function GetMappingForREQDetails(ByRef accType As String) As Object Dim REQ_DetailsColMapping As New Dictionary(Of String, String) From{ {"CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID", "CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID"}, {"WFScenario_Name", "WFScenario_Name"}, {"WFCMD_Name", "WFCMD_Name"}, {"WFTime_Name", "WFTime_Name"}, {"UNIT_OF_MEASURE","Unit_of_Measure"}, {"Funds Center","Entity"}, {"IC","IC"}, {"Account","Account"}, {"Flow","Flow"}, {"Fund Code","UD1"}, {"MDEP","UD2"}, {"APE9","UD3"}, {"Dollar Type","UD4"}, {"UD5","UD5"}, {"Object Class","UD6"}, {"UD7","UD7"}, {"UD8","UD8"}, {"Fiscal Year","Fiscal_Year"}}

End Select
'REQ_DetailsColMapping.Add("FY_Total","FY_Total") REQ_DetailsColMapping.Add("AllowUpdate","AllowUpdate") REQ_DetailsColMapping.Add("Create_Date","Create_Date") REQ_DetailsColMapping.Add("Create_User","Create_User") REQ_DetailsColMapping.Add("Update_Date","Update_Date") REQ_DetailsColMapping.Add("Update_User","Update_User")
Return REQ_DetailsColMapping End Function #Region "Get Mapping XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ"
Public Function GetMappingForREQ() As Object
Dim mapping As New CMD_SPLN_REQ() Dim mappingList As List(Of GBL_ColumnMap) = mapping.ColumnMaps Dim REQColMapping As New Dictionary(Of String, String) Dim columns As DataTable columns = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetColumns(si, "XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ") 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "columns: " & columns.Rows.Count) If Not columns Is Nothing Then For Each row As DataRow In columns.rows
Dim columnName As String = row(0).ToString Dim match = mappingList.FirstOrDefault(Function (f) f.DataTableColumnName.ToLower = columnName.ToLower)
If match IsNot Nothing Then REQColMapping.Add(match.CsvHeaderName, match.DataTableColumnName) Else REQColMapping.Add(columnName, columnName) End If
Next End If
Return REQColMapping End Function

Public Function CheckOblCarryover(row As DataRow) As Boolean If ((Not IsDbNull(row("OBL Carryover")) AndAlso Not String.IsNullOrEmpty(row("OBL Carryover").ToString()))) Return True Else Return False End If End Function

Workflow was marked ""Complete"" by Command HQ.") End If Return Nothing End Function

Public Function Additional_CustomValidations(ByRef Importreq_DT As DataTable, ByRef existingREQs As Dictionary(Of (String, String, String), String)) As Boolean
'Identify dupliacate rows to delete based on the new data Dim rowsToDelete As New List(Of String) Dim validFile As Boolean = True For Each newRow As DataRow In Importreq_DT.Rows Dim validRow As Boolean = True Dim errorMsg As String = "" Dim id As String = newRow("REQ_ID").ToString Dim status As String = newRow("Status").ToString 'Validate REQ_ID exisitance If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(id) Then Dim exists As Boolean = existingREQs.Keys.Any(Function (f) f.Item1.XFEqualsIgnoreCase(id))
If Not exists Then errorMsg = "REQ_ID: " & id & " does not exist." validFile = False validRow = False Else If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(status) Or status.XFEqualsIgnoreCase("none") Then errorMsg = "REQ_ID: " & id & " does not have status." validFile = False validRow = False End If End If End If 'BRApi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"In Additional_CustomValidations 2" & newRow("FY1") & " : " & newRow("FY2") & " : " & newRow("FY3")) 'Validate FYDP not zero Dim totalOBL As Decimal = 0 Dim OBL_OCT As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL OCT")) Then OBL_OCT = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL OCT")) Dim OBL_NOV As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL NOV")) Then OBL_NOV = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL NOV")) Dim OBL_DEC As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL DEC")) Then OBL_DEC = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL DEC")) Dim OBL_JAN As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL JAN")) Then OBL_JAN = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL JAN")) Dim OBL_FEB As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL FEB")) Then OBL_FEB = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL FEB")) Dim OBL_MAR As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL MAR")) Then OBL_MAR = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL MAR")) Dim OBL_APR As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL APR")) Then OBL_APR = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL APR")) Dim OBL_MAY As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL MAY")) Then OBL_MAY = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL MAY")) Dim OBL_JUN As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL JUN")) Then OBL_JUN = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL JUN")) Dim OBL_JUL As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL JUL")) Then OBL_JUL = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL JUL")) Dim OBL_AUG As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL AUG")) Then OBL_AUG = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL AUG")) Dim OBL_SEP As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("OBL SEP")) Then OBL_SEP = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("OBL SEP")) totalOBL = OBL_OCT + OBL_NOV + OBL_DEC + OBL_JAN + OBL_FEB + OBL_MAR + OBL_APR + OBL_MAY + OBL_JUN + OBL_JUL + OBL_AUG + OBL_SEP If totalOBL = 0 Then errorMsg = errorMsg & " Obligation Amount Total can not be zero. " End If
Dim totalCOM As Decimal = 0 Dim COM_OCT As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM OCT")) Then COM_OCT = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM OCT")) Dim COM_NOV As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM NOV")) Then COM_NOV = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM NOV")) Dim COM_DEC As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM DEC")) Then COM_DEC = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM DEC")) Dim COM_JAN As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM JAN")) Then COM_JAN = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM JAN")) Dim COM_FEB As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM FEB")) Then COM_FEB = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM FEB")) Dim COM_MAR As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM MAR")) Then COM_MAR = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM MAR")) Dim COM_APR As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM APR")) Then COM_APR = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM APR")) Dim COM_MAY As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM MAY")) Then COM_MAY = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM MAY")) Dim COM_JUN As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM JUN")) Then COM_JUN = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM JUN")) Dim COM_JUL As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM JUL")) Then COM_JUL = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM JUL")) Dim COM_AUG As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM AUG")) Then COM_AUG = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM AUG")) Dim COM_SEP As Decimal = 0 If Not String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(newRow("COM SEP")) Then COM_SEP = Convert.toDecimal( newRow("COM SEP")) totalCOM = COM_OCT + COM_NOV + COM_DEC + COM_JAN + COM_FEB + COM_MAR + COM_APR + COM_MAY + COM_JUN + COM_JUL + COM_AUG + COM_SEP If totalCOM = 0 Then errorMsg = errorMsg & " Commitment Amount Total can not be zero. " End If
If Not validRow Then newRow("Invalid Errors") = errorMsg End If Next Return validFile End Function
#End Region
#Region "Function: GetDbValuesIntoREQTables" Function GetDbValuesIntoREQTables(ByRef REQDT As DataTable, ByRef REQDTDetail As DataTable, ByRef ImportedREQs As DataTable ) As Dictionary(Of (String, String, String), String)
Dim sqa As New SqlDataAdapter() Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim scName As String = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim cmd As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName") Dim tm As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
Dim entities = ImportedREQs.AsEnumerable(). Select(Function(row) $"'{row.Field(Of String)("Funds Center")}'"). Distinct() Dim entityFilter As String = " 1 = 1" If Not entities.Any() Then entityFilter = String.Join(", ", entities) entityFilter = $"Entity In ({entityFilter})" End If
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) Using sqlConn As New SqlConnection(dbConnApp.ConnectionString) sqlConn.Open() Dim sqaREQReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ(sqlConn) Dim SqlREQ As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{scName}' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}' AND {entityFilter}"
Dim sqlparamsREQ As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaREQReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_DT(sqa, REQDT, SqlREQ, sqlparamsREQ) REQDT.PrimaryKey = New DataColumn() {REQDT.Columns("CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID")}
'Prepare Detail Dim sqaREQDetailReader As New SQA_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details(sqlConn) Dim SqlREQDetail As String = $"SELECT * FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE WFScenario_Name = '{scName}' AND WFTime_Name = '{tm}' AND {entityFilter} AND UNIT_OF_MEASURE in( 'Funding', 'UNIT_OF_MEASURE')"
Dim sqlparamsREQDetails As SqlParameter() = New SqlParameter() {} sqaREQDetailReader.Fill_XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details_DT(sqa, REQDTDetail, SqlREQDetail, sqlparamsREQDetails) End Using End Using
'Put it in a dictionary for faster access Dim existingREQs As New Dictionary(Of (String, String, String), String) For Each row As DataRow In REQDT.Rows existingREQs.Add((row("REQ_ID").ToString, row("WFScenario_Name").ToString(), row("Entity").ToString()), row("REQ_ID")) Next Return existingREQs End Function #End Region
#End Region
End Class End Namespace

#Region "Function: dg_CMD_FM_ReviewImportExecution_Detail - Get Review Import Execution Detail" Private Function dg_CMD_FM_ImportReviewExecution_Detail() As Object Dim WfYear As Integer = TimeDimHelper.GetYearFromId(si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim wfTimeNameRaw As String = BRApi.Finance.Time.GetNameFromId(si,si.WorkflowClusterPk.TimeKey) Dim iwfTimeNameRaw As Integer = wfTimeNameRaw.Split("M")(1) Dim wfTimeZeroInsert As String = String.Empty If iwfTimeNameRaw < 10 Then wfTimeZeroInsert = "00" Else wfTimeZeroInsert = "0" End If
Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "iwfTimeNameRaw = " & iwfTimeNameRaw.ToString) Dim wfTimeName As String = WfYear & wfTimeZeroInsert & iwfTimeNameRaw Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "wfTimeName = " & wfTimeName) Dim columnDefinitions As New List(Of XFDynamicGridColumnDefinition) Dim dtAdj As New DataTable()
Dim FundCode As New XFDynamicGridColumnDefinition() FundCode.ColumnName = "Fund Code" FundCode.IsFromTable = True FundCode.IsVisible = True FundCode.AllowUpdates = False columnDefinitions.Add(FundCode)
Dim MDEP As New XFDynamicGridColumnDefinition() MDEP.ColumnName = "MDEP" MDEP.IsFromTable = True MDEP.IsVisible = True MDEP.AllowUpdates = False columnDefinitions.Add(MDEP)
Dim APE9 As New XFDynamicGridColumnDefinition() APE9.ColumnName = "APE9" APE9.IsFromTable = True APE9.IsVisible = True APE9.AllowUpdates = False columnDefinitions.Add(APE9)
Dim Dollar_Type As New XFDynamicGridColumnDefinition() Dollar_Type.ColumnName = "Dollar_Type" Dollar_Type.IsFromTable = True Dollar_Type.IsVisible = True Dollar_Type.AllowUpdates = False columnDefinitions.Add(Dollar_Type)
Dim Obj_Class As New XFDynamicGridColumnDefinition() Obj_Class.ColumnName = "Obj_Class" Obj_Class.IsFromTable = True Obj_Class.IsVisible = True Obj_Class.AllowUpdates = False columnDefinitions.Add(Obj_Class)

Dim sEntity As String = args.CustomSubstVars("BL_CMD_FM_FundsCenter") Dim sFundCode As String = args.CustomSubstVars("LR_U1_CMD_FM_ReviewStatusOfFundsDetail_FundCode") Dim sMDEP As String = args.CustomSubstVars("LR_U2_CMD_FM_ReviewStatusOfFundsDetail_MDEP") Dim sAPE As String = args.CustomSubstVars("LR_U3_CMD_FM_ReviewStatusOfFundsDetail_APE") Dim sDollarType As String = args.CustomSubstVars("LR_U4_CMD_FM_ReviewStatusOfFundsDetail_DollarType") Dim sObjClass As String = args.CustomSubstVars("LR_U6_CMD_FM_ReviewStatusOfFundsDetail_ObjClass")
Dim BaseFundsCenters As List(Of MemberInfo) = BRApi.Finance.Metadata.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, "E_ARMY", $"E#{sEntity}.ChildrenInclusive",True) Dim sBaseFundsCenterList As String = "'" & String.Join("','", BaseFundsCenters.Select(Function(m) m.Member.Name)) & "'" Dim sSelectedReqDetail As String = args.CustomSubstVars.XFGetValue("DL_CMD_FM_Execution_Column_Name") Dim sql As String = String.Empty If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(sSelectedReqDetail) Then
#Region "Sql Query" sql = $"WITH AggregatedData AS ( SELECT Req.REQ_ID As 'REQ ID', Req.Title As 'REQ Title', Ufr.UFR_ID As 'UFR ID', Ufr.Title As 'UFR Title', SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' OR Dtl.Account = 'UFR_Obligations' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS [Total Requirement], SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS [AFP], SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'UFR_Obligations' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS [Funding Delta], UfrDtl.FY As 'Requested Amount', SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS [Total Obligations],
--Remaining Funding = SPLN - EXECUTION SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN -1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_C2026' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * (COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ) ) AS 'Remaining Funding',
--BURN RATE = EXECUTION / SPLN ( SUM( CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END ) * 1.0 -- Multiplying by 1.0 to ensure the result is a decimal ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_WORK' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS 'Burn Rate'
FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ As Req
INNER JOIN XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details As Dtl ON Req.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = Dtl.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR As Ufr ON Req.REQ_ID = Ufr.REQ_LINK_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR_Details as UfrDtl ON Ufr.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = UfrDtl.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No
WHERE Req.WFCMD_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}' --AND Req.WFScenario_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}' AND Req.WFTime_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}' AND Req.Entity IN ({sBaseFundsCenterList}) --AND Req.REQ_ID_Type = 'Requirement' AND Dtl.UD1 = '{sFundCode}' AND Dtl.UD2 = '{sMDEP}' AND Dtl.UD3 = '{sAPE}' AND Dtl.UD4 = '{sDollarType}' AND Dtl.UD6 = '{sObjClass}' GROUP BY Req.REQ_ID, Req.Title, Ufr.UFR_ID, Ufr.Title, UfrDtl.FY ) SELECT *, CASE WHEN [Total Requirement] > [AFP] THEN 'Funded' WHEN [Total Requirement] = [AFP] THEN 'Balanced' ELSE 'Underfunded' END AS [Funding Status] FROM AggregatedData;
" Else sql = $"SELECT REQ_ID, {sSelectedReqDetail} FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ WHERE Entity IN ({sBaseFundsCenterList}) "
End If
#End Region
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dtAdj = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp,sql,False) End Using

Return taskResult
End Function #End Region

--Remaining Funding = SPLN - EXECUTION SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN -1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_C2026' THEN 1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Commitments' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN -1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Commitments' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_C2026' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * (COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ) ) AS 'Remaining Funding',
--BURN RATE = EXECUTION / SPLN ( SUM( CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Commitments' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END ) * 1.0 -- Multiplying by 1.0 to ensure the result is a decimal ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_WORK' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS 'Burn Rate'
FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ As Req
INNER JOIN XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details As Dtl ON Req.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = Dtl.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR As Ufr ON Req.REQ_ID = Ufr.REQ_LINK_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR_Details as UfrDtl ON Ufr.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = UfrDtl.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No
WHERE Req.WFCMD_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}' AND Req.WFTime_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}' AND Req.Entity IN ({sBaseFundsCenterList}) --AND Req.REQ_ID_Type = 'Requirement' AND Req.REQ_ID = '{sREQID}' AND Dtl.Fiscal_Year = '{WFTime}' GROUP BY Req.REQ_ID, Req.Title, Ufr.UFR_ID, Ufr.Title, UfrDtl.FY ) SELECT *, CASE WHEN [Total Requirement] > [AFP] THEN 'Funded' WHEN [Total Requirement] = [AFP] THEN 'Balanced' ELSE 'Underfunded' END AS [Funding Status] FROM AggregatedData;
"
#End Region
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dtAdj = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp,sql,False) End Using
' 'Create the XFTable Dim xfTable As New xfDataTable(si,dtAdj,Nothing,1000)
'Send the result To the Interface component Dim taskResult As New XFDynamicGridGetDataResult(xfTable,columnDefinitions,DataAccessLevel.AllAccess)
Return taskResult
End Function #End Region

'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS [Total Obligations],
--Remaining Funding = SPLN - EXECUTION SUM(CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN -1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_C2026' THEN 1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Commitments' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN -1 WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Commitments' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_C2026' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END * (COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ) ) AS 'Remaining Funding',
--BURN RATE = EXECUTION / SPLN ( SUM( CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Commitments' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'Execution' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END ) * 1.0 -- Multiplying by 1.0 to ensure the result is a decimal ) / NULLIF( SUM( CASE WHEN Dtl.Account = 'Obligations' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = 'CMD_SPLN_WORK' THEN COALESCE(Dtl.Month1,0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month2, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month3, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month4, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month5, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month6, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month7, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month8, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month9, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month10, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month11, 0) + COALESCE(Dtl.Month12, 0) ELSE 0 END ), 0 ) AS 'Burn Rate'
FROM XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ As Req
INNER JOIN XFC_CMD_SPLN_REQ_Details As Dtl ON Req.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID = Dtl.CMD_SPLN_REQ_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR As Ufr ON Req.REQ_ID = Ufr.REQ_LINK_ID
LEFT JOIN XFC_CMD_UFR_Details as UfrDtl ON Ufr.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No = UfrDtl.CMD_UFR_Tracking_No
WHERE Req.WFCMD_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("CMDName")}' AND Req.WFScenario_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName")}' AND Req.WFTime_Name = '{wfInfoDetails("TimeName")}' AND Req.Entity IN ({sBaseFundsCenterList}) --AND Req.REQ_ID_Type = 'Requirement' AND Req.REQ_ID = '{sREQID}' AND Dtl.Fiscal_Year = '{WFTime}' GROUP BY Req.REQ_ID, Req.Title, Ufr.UFR_ID, Ufr.Title, UfrDtl.FY, Dtl.Account,Req.APPN, Req.MDEP, Req.APE9, Req.Dollar_Type, Dtl.Month1, Dtl.Month1, Dtl.Month2, Dtl.Month3, Dtl.Month4, Dtl.Month5, Dtl.Month6, Dtl.Month7, Dtl.Month8, Dtl.Month9, Dtl.Month10, Dtl.Month11, Dtl.Month12 ) SELECT *, CASE WHEN [Total Requirement] > [AFP] THEN 'Funded' WHEN [Total Requirement] = [AFP] THEN 'Balanced' ELSE 'Underfunded' END AS [Funding Status] FROM AggregatedData;
"
#End Region
Using dbConnApp As DbConnInfoApp = BRApi.Database.CreateApplicationDbConnInfo(si) dtAdj = BRApi.Database.ExecuteSql(dbConnApp,sql,False) End Using
' 'Create the XFTable Dim xfTable As New xfDataTable(si,dtAdj,Nothing,1000)
'Send the result To the Interface component Dim taskResult As New XFDynamicGridGetDataResult(xfTable,columnDefinitions,DataAccessLevel.AllAccess)
Return taskResult
End Function #End Region
End Class End Namespace

Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800 Imports Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly Imports Microsoft.Data.SqlClient
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName Public Class CMD_FM_FinCustCalc Implements IWsasFinanceCustomCalculateV800
Public si As SessionInfo Public globals As BRGlobals Public api As FinanceRulesApi Public args As FinanceRulesArgs Public Global_Functions As OneStream.BusinessRule.Finance.Global_Functions.MainClass
Public Sub CustomCalculate(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal brGlobals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As FinanceRulesApi, ByVal args As FinanceRulesArgs) Implements IWsasFinanceCustomCalculateV800.CustomCalculate Try Me.si = si Me.api = api Me.args = args Me.globals = globals Me.Global_Functions = New OneStream.BusinessRule.Finance.Global_Functions.MainClass(si,globals,api,args)
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Load_FM_Execution_to_Cube") Then Me.Load_FM_Execution_to_Cube() End If
If args.CustomCalculateArgs.FunctionName.XFContainsIgnoreCase("Copy_SPLN_Scenario_To_FM") Then Me.Copy_SPLN_Scenario_To_FM() End If
Catch ex As Exception Throw New XFException(si, ex) End Try End Sub
#Region "Function: Load_FM_Execution_to_Cube - Load Execution data to Cube" Public Sub Load_FM_Execution_to_Cube() Dim tgt_Origin As String = "AdjInput" Dim tgt_Flow As String = "Top" ' Dim tgt_Acct As String = "Obligations"
Dim entDimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "E_Army") Dim EntBase = Not BRApi.Finance.Members.HasChildren(si, entDimPk, api.Pov.Entity.MemberId) Dim EntityLevel As String = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetEntityLevel(si,api.Pov.Entity.Name)
Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim sScenario As String = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim sTime As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName")
Dim mbrComd = BRApi.Finance.Metadata.GetMember(si, dimTypeId.Entity, wfInfoDetails("CMDName")).Member Dim BaseFundsCenters As List(Of MemberInfo) = BRApi.Finance.Metadata.GetMembersUsingFilter(si, "E_ARMY", "E#Army.base",True) Dim sBaseFundsCenterList As String = "'" & String.Join("','", BaseFundsCenters.Select(Function(m) m.Member.Name)) & "'"
Dim FM_Import_DT As DataTable = BRApi.Utilities.GetSessionDataTable(si,si.UserName, $"CMD_FM_Import_Execution_{sScenario}_{mbrComd.Name}_{sTime}")
#Region "Check parent entities passed over" brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"FinCustCalc - FM_Import_DT Count = " & FM_Import_DT.Rows.Count) Dim headers As New Text.StringBuilder() For Each col As DataColumn In FM_Import_DT.Columns headers.AppendLine(col.ColumnName) Next #End Region
Dim CurrCubeBuffer As DataBuffer = api.Data.GetDataBufferUsingFormula($"FilterMembers(REMOVEZeros(V#Periodic),[O#{tgt_Origin}],[F#{tgt_Flow}])") Dim destBuffer As DataBuffer = New DataBuffer() Dim ClearCubeData As DataBuffer = New DataBuffer()
Dim FCList As List(Of String) = FM_Import_DT.AsEnumerable().Select(Function(row) row.Field(Of String)("Entity")).ToList() Dim EntityLists = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetEntityLists(si,FCList,"CMD_FM") Dim ParentEntityList As String = String.Join(", ", EntityLists.Item1.Select(Function(s) $"E#{s}")) Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "ParentEntityList = " & ParentEntityList) ' Dim filteredRows = FM_Import_DT.AsEnumerable(). ' Where(Function(r) Not IsDBNull(r("Entity")) AndAlso ' ParentEntityList.XFContainsIgnoreCase(r("Entity")))
Dim filteredRows = FM_Import_DT.AsEnumerable(). Where(Function(r) Not IsDBNull(r("Entity")) AndAlso String.Equals(r("Entity").ToString(), api.Pov.Entity.Name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)).ToList()
brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si,"filtered rows count = " & filteredRows.Count)
For Each row As DataRow In filteredRows Dim tgtcellPk As New DataBufferCellPk() Dim status As New DataCellStatus(True) Dim tgtDataCell As New DataBufferCell(tgtcellPk, 0, status) Dim Destcell As New DataBufferCell(UpdateCellDefinition(tgtDataCell,row("Account").ToString,tgt_Flow,tgt_Origin,"None",row("U1_FundCode").ToString(),row("U2_MDEP").ToString(),row("U3_All_APE").ToString(),row("U4_DollarType").ToString,row("U5_CType").ToString,row("U6_CommitItem").ToString,row("U7_UIC").ToString,"None")) If Not IsDBNull(row("Amount")) AndAlso row("Amount") <> 0 Then Destcell.CellAmount = Convert.ToDecimal(row("Amount")) UpdateValue(Destcell, CurrCubeBuffer, destBuffer, Destcell.CellAmount) CurrCubeBuffer.DataBufferCells.Remove(Destcell.DataBufferCellPk) End If Next
Dim destInfo As ExpressionDestinationInfo = api.Data.GetExpressionDestinationInfo("V#Periodic") If destBuffer.DataBufferCells.Count > 0 Then api.Data.SetDataBuffer(destBuffer, destInfo,,,,,,,,,,,,, True) destBuffer.DataBufferCells.Clear() End If For Each ClearCubeCell As DataBufferCell In CurrCubeBuffer.DataBufferCells.Values Dim Status As New DataCellStatus(False) Dim ClearCell As New DataBufferCell(ClearCubeCell.DataBufferCellPk, 0, Status) ClearCubeData.SetCell(si, ClearCell) Next Dim ClearInfo = api.Data.GetExpressionDestinationInfo("V#Periodic") If ClearCubeData.DataBufferCells.Count > 0 Then api.Data.SetDataBuffer(ClearCubeData, ClearInfo) End If
End Sub #End Region
#Region "Function: Copy_SPLN_Scenario_To_FM - Load Execution data to Cube" Public Sub Copy_SPLN_Scenario_To_FM()
Dim wfInfoDetails = Workspace.GBL.GBL_Assembly.GBL_Helpers.GetWFInfoDetails(si) Dim scName As String = wfInfoDetails("ScenarioName") Dim tmName As String = wfInfoDetails("TimeName") Dim cmdName As String = wfInfoDetails("CMDName")
Dim tgt_Origin As String = "AdjInput" Dim tgt_Flow As String = "YOE_Baseline" Dim origin_Filter As String = "O#AdjInput,O#AdjConsolidated,O#Import"
'Source Buffer Dim sourceFormula As String = $"FilterMembers(REMOVEZeros(S#CMD_SPLN_C{tmName}),Cb#{cmdName},[{origin_Filter}])"
Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Formula used for cell selection: " & sourceFormula)
Dim sourceBuffer As DataBuffer = api.Data.GetDataBufferUsingFormula(sourceFormula)
Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, $"Source buffer count = {sourceBuffer.DataBufferCells.Count} cells")
If sourceBuffer.DataBufferCells.Count = 0 Then Exit Sub End If
'Prepare Data buffer for clearing and writing
'Clear Buffer Dim clearBuffer As New DataBuffer()
'Destination Buffer Dim destBuffer As New DataBuffer()
'Get the dimension ID for the Flow Member Dim FlowDimPk As DimPk = BRApi.Finance.Dim.GetDimPk(si, "F_CMD_SPLN_Ops")
'Get the memberId for the baseline flow member Dim flowMemberId As Integer = api.Members.GetMemberId(DimType.Flow.Id, tgt_Flow)
For Each sourceCell As DataBufferCell In sourceBuffer.DataBufferCells.Values 'Create a zero cell to clear Dim zeroCell As New DataBufferCell(sourceCell.DataBufferCellPk, 0, New DataCellStatus(False)) clearBuffer.SetCell(si, zeroCell)
'Create a copy of source cell's primary key to modify it Dim destPk As New DataBufferCellPk(sourceCell.DataBufferCellPk)
'Set the Flow Member Id in the destination primary key destPk.FlowId = flowMemberId
'Create a copy of the source cell for the destination buffer Dim destCell As New DataBufferCell(destPk, sourceCell.CellAmount, sourceCell.CellStatus) destBuffer.SetCell(si, destCell)
Next
'Execute Clear and Write Operations
'Define the destination slice for both operations Dim destInfo As ExpressionDestinationInfo = api.Data.GetExpressionDestinationInfo("S#CMD_SPLN_WORK")
'Clear the destination by writing the clear buffer If clearBuffer.DataBufferCells.Count > 0 Then api.Data.SetDataBuffer(clearBuffer, destInfo,,,,,,,,,,,,,True) Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Destination slice has been cleared") End If
'Write the new data by writing the destBuffer If destBuffer.DataBufferCells.Count > 0 Then api.Data.SetDataBuffer(destBuffer, DestInfo,,,,,,,,,,,,,True) Brapi.ErrorLog.LogMessage(si, "Destination slice has been updated with source") destBuffer.LogDataBuffer(api, "dest Buffer = ", 20) End If
End Sub #End Region
#Region "Helper Functions" ''------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function UpdateCellDefinition(ByRef destcell As DataBufferCell,Optional ByRef DriverDB_Acct As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_Flow As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_Origin As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_IC As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD1 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD2 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD3 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD4 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD5 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD6 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD7 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD8 As String = "NoPassedValue") As DatabufferCell
Dim BufferCell = Global_Functions.UpdateCellDefinition(destcell,DriverDB_Acct,DriverDB_Flow,DriverDB_Origin,DriverDB_IC,DriverDB_UD1,DriverDB_UD2,DriverDB_UD3,DriverDB_UD4,DriverDB_UD5,DriverDB_UD6,DriverDB_UD7,DriverDB_UD8) Return BufferCell
End Function
''------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Function GetBCValue(ByRef srccell As DataBufferCell,ByRef DriverDB As DataBuffer,Optional ByRef DriverDB_Acct As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_Flow As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_Origin As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_IC As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD1 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD2 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD3 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD4 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD5 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD6 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD7 As String = "NoPassedValue",Optional ByRef DriverDB_UD8 As String = "NoPassedValue") As Decimal
Return Global_Functions.GetBCValue(srccell,DriverDB,DriverDB_Acct,DriverDB_Flow,DriverDB_Origin,DriverDB_IC,DriverDB_UD1,DriverDB_UD2,DriverDB_UD3,DriverDB_UD4,DriverDB_UD5,DriverDB_UD6,DriverDB_UD7,DriverDB_UD8)
End Function
''------------------------------------------------------------------------- Public Sub UpdateValue(ByRef srcCell As DataBufferCell, ByRef currCellDB As DataBuffer, ByRef destDB As DataBuffer, ByVal value As Decimal)
Global_Functions.UpdateValue(srccell,currCellDB,destDB,value)
End Sub
#End Region
End Class End Namespace

Imports System Imports System.Collections.Generic Imports System.Data Imports System.Data.Common Imports System.Globalization Imports System.IO Imports System.Linq Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports OneStream.Finance.Database Imports OneStream.Finance.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Common Imports OneStream.Shared.Database Imports OneStream.Shared.Engine Imports OneStream.Shared.Wcf Imports OneStream.Stage.Database Imports OneStream.Stage.Engine Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi Imports OneStreamWorkspacesApi.V800
Namespace Workspace.__WsNamespacePrefix.__WsAssemblyName.BusinessRule.DashboardStringFunction.CMD_FM_DataBuffers Public Class MainClass Public si As SessionInfo Public globals As BRGlobals Public api As Object Public args As DashboardStringFunctionArgs Public Function Main(ByVal si As SessionInfo, ByVal globals As BRGlobals, ByVal api As Object, ByVal args As DashboardStringFunctionArgs) As Object Try
Me.si = si Me.globals = globals Me.api = api Me.args = args
Select Case args.FunctionName
Case "ImportReviewExecutionKey5Detail" Return Me.ImportReviewExecutionKey5Detail() Case "ReviewStatusOfFundsSummary" Return Me.ReviewStatusOfFundsSummary()
End Select
Return Nothing Catch ex As Exception Throw New XFException(si, ex) End Try End Function
#Region "Function: ImportReviewExecutionKey5Detail - Return Key 5 detail of Execution for Funds Center selected" 'XFBR(Workspace.CMD_FM.CMD_FM_Assembly.CMD_FM_DataBuffers, ImportReviewExecutionKey5Detail, Entity=[], Scenario=[]) Public Function ImportReviewExecutionKey5Detail() As Object Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim Entity As String = args.NameValuePairs("Entity") Dim lEntity As List(Of String) = StringHelper.SplitString(Entity, ",") Dim Scenario As String = args.NameValuePairs("Scenario")
Dim toSort As New Dictionary(Of String, String) Dim output = "" Dim FilterString As String If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Entity) Then Return "E#None:U1#None:U3#None" FilterString = String.Empty If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FilterString) Then FilterString = $"Cb#{sCube}:C#USD:S#{Scenario}:E#[{Entity}]:V#Periodic:O#Top:I#None:F#Top:U8#None" Else FilterString = $"{FilterString} + Cb#{sCube}:C#USD:S#{Scenario}:E#[{Entity}]:V#Periodic:O#Top:I#None:F#Top:U8#None" End If globals.SetStringValue("Filter", $"REMOVENODATA({FilterString})")
GetDataBuffer(si, globals, api, args)
If Not globals.GetObject("Results") Is Nothing
Dim results As Dictionary(Of MemberScriptBuilder, DataBufferCell) = globals.GetObject("Results")
For Each msb In results.Keys msb.Scenario = Scenario msb.Entity = Entity msb.Account = vbNullString msb.Origin = vbNullString msb.IC = vbNullString msb.Flow = vbNullString msb.UD8 = vbNullString If Not toSort.ContainsKey(msb.GetMemberScript) Then toSort.Add(msb.GetMemberScript, $"E#{msb.entity}") End If Next End If ' Next
Dim sorted As Dictionary(Of String, String) = toSort.OrderByDescending(Function(x) x.Value).ToDictionary(Function(x) x.Key, Function(y) y.Value)
For Each item In sorted output &= item.key & "," Next
If output = "" Then output = "U5#One" End If
Return output End Function #End Region
#Region "Function: ReviewStatusOfFundsSummary"
Public Function ReviewStatusOfFundsSummary() As Object Dim sCube As String = BRApi.Workflow.Metadata.GetProfile(si, si.WorkflowClusterPk.ProfileKey).CubeName Dim Entity As String = args.NameValuePairs("Entity") Dim lEntity As List(Of String) = StringHelper.SplitString(Entity, ",") Dim Scenario As String = args.NameValuePairs("Scenario") Dim toSort As New Dictionary(Of String, String) Dim output = "" Dim FilterString As String If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Entity) Then Return "E#None:U1#None:U3#None" FilterString = String.Empty If String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(FilterString) Then FilterString = $"Cb#{sCube}:C#USD:S#{Scenario}:E#[{Entity}]:V#Periodic:O#Top:I#None:F#Top:U8#None" & _ $" + Cb#{sCube}:C#USD:S#Execution:E#[{Entity}]:V#Periodic:O#Top:I#None:F#Top:U8#None" Else FilterString = $"{FilterString} + Cb#{sCube}:C#USD:S#{Scenario}:E#[{Entity}]:V#Periodic:O#Top:I#None:F#Top:U8#None" End If globals.SetStringValue("Filter", $"REMOVENODATA({FilterString})")
GetDataBuffer(si, globals, api, args) If Not globals.GetObject("Results") Is Nothing
Dim results As Dictionary(Of MemberScriptBuilder, DataBufferCell) = globals.GetObject("Results")
For Each msb In results.Keys msb.Scenario = Scenario msb.Entity = Entity msb.Account = vbNullString msb.Origin = vbNullString msb.IC = vbNullString msb.Flow = vbNullString msb.UD8 = vbNullString If Not toSort.ContainsKey(msb.GetMemberScript) Then toSort.Add(msb.GetMemberScript, $"E#{msb.entity}") End If Next End If ' Next Dim sorted As Dictionary(Of String, String) = toSort.OrderByDescending(Function(x) x.Value).ToDictionary(Function(x) x.Key, Function(y) y.Value)
For Each item In sorted output &= item.key & "," Next
If output = "" Then output = "U5#One" End If
Return output
End Function #End Region
#Region "Utilities: Get DataBuffer"
Public Sub GetDataBuffer(ByRef si As SessionInfo, ByRef globals As BRGlobals, ByRef api As Object, ByRef args As DashboardStringFunctionArgs)
Dim Dictionary As New Dictionary(Of String, String)
BRApi.Finance.Calculate.ExecuteCustomCalculateBusinessRule(si, "Global_Buffers", "GetCVDataBuffer", Dictionary, customcalculatetimetype.CurrentPeriod)
End Sub
#End Region
End Class End Namespace
